பதசிய வளிமண்டலவியல் நிழலயத்தின் முன்னறிவிப்புப் பிாிவால் வவளியிடப்பட்டது
அடுத்த 24 மணித்தியாலத்துக்கான, நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள கடற் பைப்பிற்கான
வானிழல முன்னறிவிப்பு
2026 பெப்ரவரி 11ஆம் திகதி அதிகரலை 05.30 மணிக்கு வவளியிடப்பட்டது.
மழை நிழலழம:
ஹம்பாந்பதாட்ழடயிலிருந்து வபாத்துவில் ஊடாக மட்டக்களப்பு வழையான
கழைபயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகளில் சில இடங்களில் மழை வபய்யக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள ஏழனய கடற்பைப்புகளில் பிைதானமாக சீைான வானிழல நிலவும்
என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
காற்று :
நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள கடற்பைப்புகளில் காற்றானது வடகிைக்கு திழசயிலிருந்து வீசக்
கூடும். காற்றின் பவகமானது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 30-40 கிபலா மீற்றர் வழை
காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
வகாழும்பிலிருந்து புத்தளம் ஊடாக மன்னார் வழையான கழைபயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
கடற்பைப்புகளிலும் மாத்தழறயிலிருந்து ஹம்பாந்பதாட்ழட ஊடாக வபாத்துவில்
வழையான கழைபயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகளிலும் காற்றின் பவகமானது
அவ்வப்பபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 45-50 கிபலா மீற்றர் வழை அதிகாிக்கக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
கடல் நிழல:
வகாழும்பிலிருந்து புத்தளம் ஊடாக மன்னார் வழையான கழைபயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட

வகாந்தளிப்பாகக் காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 12 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 11 February 2026
The prevailing dry weather conditions are expected to change from tomorrow (12th).
Showers will occur at times in North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces and in
Hambantota district. Fairly Heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva
provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa, Polonnaruwa and Hambantota districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
showers above 50 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-
western, and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 11 February 2026
Tonight
Except for a few showers in the Ampara, Batticaloa, Monaragala and Hambantota districts, mainly fair
weather will prevail over the island.
Tomorrow
The prevailing dry weather conditions are expected to change from tomorrow (12th).
Showers will occur at times in North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces and in Hambantota
district. Fairly Heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva provinces and in
Ampara, Batticaloa, Polonnaruwa and Hambantota districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy showers
above 50 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western,
and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 12 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota
to Kankasanthurai via Pottuvil and Trincomalee. Showers or thundershowers may occur at
several places in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up
to (45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to
Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and Mannar and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and
Mannar and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea
areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon 12 February 2026 valid for the period until 11.00 p.m. 12 February 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces.
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Thundershowers accompanied with severe
lightning are likely to occur at some places in
Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces.
There may be temporary localized strong winds
during thundershowers. General public is kindly
requested to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology advises that
people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and never
under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy fields, tea
plantations and open water bodies during
thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected
electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles,
tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 13 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 12 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central, Uva, Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa district. Fairly
heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Uva province and in Ampara, Batticaloa,
Nuwara-Eliya, Matale and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura and Hambanthota
districts.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
showers above 50 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province, Kaluthara, Galle and
Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 12 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota to
Pottuvil via Trincomalee. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in the other sea
areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Beruwala to Kankasanthurai
via Colombo, Puttalam and Mannar and from Hambantota to Pottuvil.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Beruwala to Kankasanthurai via Colombo, Puttalam and
Mannar and from Hambantota to Pottuvil will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the
island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 12 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central, Uva, Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa district. Fairly
heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Uva province and in Ampara, Batticaloa, Nuwara-
Eliya, Matale and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura and Hambanthota
districts.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy showers
above 50 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province, Kaluthara, Galle and Matara
districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and provinces and in Galle
and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 13 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 13 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central, Uva, Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa and
Hambantota districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Uva
province and in Ampara, Batticaloa, Nuwara-Eliya, Matale and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
showers above 50 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province, Kaluthara, Galle
and Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and provinces and
in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 13 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers may occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota to
Pottuvil via Trincomalee. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in the other
sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up
to (45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kalutara to
Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and Mannar and from Hambantota to Pottuvil.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kalutara to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and Mannar
and from Hambantota to Pottuvil will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island
will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon 13 February 2026 valid for the period until 11.00 p.m. 13 February 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces.
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Thundershowers accompanied with severe
lightning are likely to occur at some places in
Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces.
There may be temporary localized strong winds
during thundershowers. General public is kindly
requested to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology advises that
people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and never
under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy fields, tea
plantations and open water bodies during
thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected
electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 14 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 13 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central, Uva, Eastern and Northern provinces and in Polonnaruwa
and Hambantota districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Uva and
Central provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. and fairly heavy
showers about 75 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Kankasanthurai via Pottuvil and Trincomalee. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several
places in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.

will be moderate.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 14 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 14 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa and
Hambantota districts. Fairly heavy falls about 50 mm are likely at some places in Uva and
Central provinces and in Ampara and Batticaloa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern and North-central provinces and in
Trincomalee district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. and fairly
heavy showers about 75 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle and Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 14 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers may occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota to
Trincomalee via Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in the other
sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up
to (45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via
Puttalam and from Hambantota to Pottuvil.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from
Hambantota to Pottuvil will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be
moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 11.30 a.m. 14 February 2026 valid for the period until 11.30 p.m. 14 February 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern provinces and Badulla, Nuwara-
Eliya districts
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Thundershowers accompanied with severe
lightning are likely to occur at some places in
Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces
and in Badulla and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 1.00
p.m.
There may be temporary localized strong winds
during thundershowers. General public is kindly
requested to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology advises that
people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and never
under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy fields, tea
plantations and open water bodies during
thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 14 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara and Hambantota districts.
Fairly heavy falls about 50 mm are likely at some places in these areas.
Several spells of showers may occur in Northern and North-central provinces and in Trincomalee
and Batticaloa districts.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. and fairly heavy
showers about 75 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 14 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle
to Trincomalee via Hambantota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several
places in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via
Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be
moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 14 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara and Hambantota districts.
Fairly heavy falls about 50 mm are likely at some places in these areas.
Several spells of showers may occur in Northern and North-central provinces and in Trincomalee
and Batticaloa districts.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. and fairly heavy
showers about 75 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central provinces
and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa and
Hambantota districts.
A few showers may occur in Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in
Trincomalee district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
showers about 75 mm are likely at some places in Rathnapura, Kalutara, Galle and Matara
districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Galle to Batticaloa via Hambantota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a
few places in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up
to (45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via
Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara
to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will
be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Bulletin No: 01 LLA/26/02/15/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon 15 February 2026 valid for the period until 11.30 p.m. 15 February 2026
For Kaluthara, Galle, Matara and Rathnapura districts
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Thundershowers accompanied with severe
lightning are likely to occur at some places in in
Kaluthara, Galle, Matara and Rathnapura districts
after 1.00 p.m.
There may be temporary localized strong winds
during thundershowers. General public is kindly
requested to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology advises that
people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and never
under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy fields, tea
plantations and open water bodies during
thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected
electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 16 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 15 February 2026
Several spells of showers will occur in Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa and
Hambantota districts.
Showers or thundershowers are likely at several places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy showers above 50 mm are likely at
some places in Rathnapura, Kaluthara, Galle and Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS

Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Galle to Batticaloa via Hambantota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Galle via Kaluthara in the evening or
night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam
and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be
moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 16 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 16 February 2026
Several spells of showers will occur in Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa
and Hambantota districts.
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Western and Sabaragamuwa
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 16 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Galle to Batticaloa via Hambantota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may occur
at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Galle via Kaluthara in
the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up
to (45-50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via
Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara
to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will
be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 17 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 16 February 2026
Showery condition is expected to enhance in Northern, Northcentral, Central, Uva and Eastern
provinces in next few days from tomorrow (17th).
Showers will occur at times in Northern, Northcentral, Central, Uva, Eastern provinces and in
Hambantota district. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva and Eastern
provinces and in Polonnaruwa district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy showers
about 75 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Northcentral, Sabaragamuwa and Central provinces
and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 16 February 2026
A low-pressure area formed over Bay of Bengal sea area near 4.5N, 89.0E at 8.30 am today. Navel and
fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins issued by the
Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota
to Trincomalee via Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the other sea
areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from
Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

PLEASE BE AWARE!
A low-pressure area formed over Bay of Bengal sea area to the south east of Sri Lanka near
4.5N, 89.0E at 8.30 am today. Due to its influence, heavy showers or thundershowers, Strong
winds about (50-60) kmph, and rough or very rough seas can be expected in this sea area.

and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins issued
by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 16 February 2026
Tonight
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and
in Galle and Matara districts.
Tomorrow
Showery condition is expected to enhance in Northern, Northcentral, Central, Uva and Eastern
provinces in next few days from tomorrow (17th).
Showers will occur at times in Northern, Northcentral, Central, Uva, Eastern provinces and in
Hambantota district. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva and Eastern
provinces and in Polonnaruwa district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
showers about 75 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Northcentral, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 17 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 17 February 2026
Showery condition is expected to enhance in Northern, Northcentral, Central, Uva and
Eastern provinces in next few days from today.
Showers will occur at times in Northern, Northcentral, Central, Uva, Eastern provinces and in
Hambantota district. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva
and Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
showers about 75 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Northcentral, Sabaragamuwa and Central
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 17 February 2026
A low-pressure area formed over the central parts of south Bay of Bengal to the south east of Sri
Lanka. Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and
bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Hambantota to Trincomalee via Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in
the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 18 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 17 February 2026
Showery condition is expected to enhance in Northern, North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern
provinces in next few days from today (17 February).
Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces and in
Hambantota district. Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Eastern, Uva and North-
central provinces and in Matale and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle
and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 17 February 2026
A low-pressure area still persists over the central parts of south Bay of Bengal to the south east of Sri
Lanka. Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and
bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota
to Trincomalee via Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the other sea
areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from
Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 18 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Central, Uva, Eastern and Southern
provinces. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Eastern and Uva provinces
and in Polonnaruwa, Matale and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 18 February 2026
The low-pressure area still persists over the central parts of south Bay of Bengal to the south east
of Sri Lanka. Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts
and bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be north-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kaluthara to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 19 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 18 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces and in Hambantota
district. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Uva province and in Matale,
Batticaloa, Ampara and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern Province.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle
and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

අන්‍ය වැකි සහා නිපේදන්‍ය පිළිබඳව අව න්‍යපයන් ෙසුවන්‍ය පලංස ඉල්ලං සිටිනු ලංැපේ.

ොේල සිට ම්බන්හතාට ස මඩකලපුව ර ා ිකුණාමලය දක්වා හවරළට ඔබ්හබන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රහේශවල විටින්

ස්ථාන ස්වේපයක වැසි හ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
සුළඟ:

හකාළඹ සිට පුත්තලම ර ා මන්නාරම දක්වා ස මාතර සිට ම්බන්හතාට ර ා හපාතුවිේ දක්වා හවරළට
ඔබ්හබන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රහේශ විටින් විට තරමක් රළු හේ. දිවයින වටා වන හසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රහේශ මද වශහයන් රළු හේ.
ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති වන්‍ය විට එමා මුහුදු ප්‍රපේශ්‍වලං ත වකා ලිකාව තද සුළ ඇති විය හාැකි අතර එවිට එමා මුහුදු ප්‍රපේශ්‍
ත වකා ලිකාව ඉත රළු විය හාැකා.
WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 18 February 2026
The low-pressure area still persists over the Southwest Bay of Bengal to the south-east of Sri Lanka.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in
the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Mannar via Puttalam and from
Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Mannar via Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

2026 பெப்ரவரி 18ஆம் திைதி பிற்பைல் 01.00 மணியில் தவளியிடப்பட்டது

நுவதரலியர மரவட்டங்ைளுக்கும்:
தயவுதசய்து அவதரைமரை இருக்ைவும்!
ஊவர மரைரணத்திலும் தபர ன்ைறுகவ,

நுவதரலியர மரவட்டங்ைளிலும் சி

மகைவீழ்ச்சி எதிர்பரர்க்ைப்படுைின்றது.
எைலவ இடியுடன் கூடிய மகை தபய்யும்

ைரற்று மற்றும் ைடும் மின்ைல்

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 19 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 19 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Uva, Central and Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa district.
Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Uva province and in Matale, Batticaloa,
Ampara and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern Province and in Anuradhapura and Hambantota
districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central
and North-western provinces and in Matale, Trincomalee and Hambantota districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 19 February 2026
The low-pressure area still persists over the Southwest Bay of Bengal to the south-east of Sri Lanka.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam
and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and from Matara
to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be
moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon 19 February 2026 valid for the period until 11.00 p.m. 19 February 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa provinces, and in Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and
Matara districts.
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Thundershowers accompanied with severe
lightning are likely to occur at some places in in
Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00
p.m.
There may be temporary localized strong winds
during thundershowers. General public is kindly
requested to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology advises that
people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and never
under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy fields, tea
plantations and open water bodies during
thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை தபய்யும் லவழளகளில் தபாதுமக்கள்
பின்வரும் அறிவுழைகழளப் பின்பற்றுமாறு வளிமண்டலவியல் திழணக்களம் ஆலலாசழன

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 20 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 19 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Eastern, Uva and Central provinces. Fairly
heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Eastern province and in Matale, Badulla,
Mullaittivu and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers may occur in Hambantota district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls
about 50 mm are likely at some places in Rathnapura and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle
and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 19 February 2026
The low-pressure area still persists over the Southwest Bay of Bengal to the south-east of Sri Lanka.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in
the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam
and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 20 February 2026
Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Eastern, Uva and Central provinces.
Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Eastern province and in Matale,
Badulla, Mullaitivu and Polonnaruwa districts.
Several spells of showers may occur in Hambantota district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy
falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Rathnapura, Galle, Matara and Nuwara-Eliya
districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 20 February 2026
The low-pressure area still persists over the Southwest Bay of Bengal to the south-east of Sri Lanka.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regards.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam
and from Matara to Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam and from Matara
to Hambantota will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.30 noon 20 February 2026 valid for the period until 11.00 p.m. 20 February 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Thundershowers accompanied with severe
lightning are likely to occur at some places in in
Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces
after 2.00 p.m.
There may be temporary localized strong winds
during thundershowers. General public is kindly
requested to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology advises that
people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and never
under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy fields, tea
plantations and open water bodies during
thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected
electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

லமல், சப்ைகமுவ மற்றும் ததன் மாகாணங்களில் சில இடங்களில்
பி.ப. 2.00 மணிக்குப் பின்னர் கடும் மின்னல் தாக்கத்துடன் கூடிய
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை தபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
காணப்படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை தபய்யும் லவழளகளில் அப்
பிைலதசங்களில் தற்காலிகமாக பலத்த காற்றும் வீசக்கூடும்.
மின்னல் தாக்கங்களினால் ஏற்படக்கூடிய பாதிப்புகழள
குழறத்துக்தகாள்ள லதழவயான முன்தனச்சாிக்ழக
நடவடிக்ழககழள எடுத்துக் தகாள்ளுமாறு தபாதுமக்கள்
அறிவுறுத்தப்படுகின்றார்கள்.
எடுக்க லவண்டிய நடவடிக்ழககள்:
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை தபய்யும் லவழளகளில் தபாதுமக்கள்
பின்வரும் அறிவுழைகழளப் பின்பற்றுமாறு வளிமண்டலவியல் திழணக்களம் ஆலலாசழன
வைங்குகின்றது.
• உள்ளகப் பகுதிகளில் புகலிடம் லதடுங்கள். மைங்களின் கீழ் ஒருலபாதும் நிற்க லவண்டாம்.
• இடி முைக்கத்தின் லபாது தநல்வயல்கள், லதயிழலத் லதாட்டங்கள், திறந்த நீர்நிழலகள்
லபான்றவற்ழறத் தவிர்த்துக் தகாள்ளவும்.
• இடி முைக்கத்தின் லபாது கம்பித்ததாடர்புள்ள ததாழலலபசி மற்றும் மின்னிழணப்பிலுள்ள மின்

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 21 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 20 February 2026
Atmospheric conditions are favorable for thundershowers over most parts of the island and
showery condition is expected to enhance tomorrow (21).
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the Northern, North-Central, Eastern, Uva and
Central provinces and in the Hambantota district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m.
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in the Batticaloa, Ampara and Polonnaruwa districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely
at some places elsewhere.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle,
Matara and Kaluthara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 20 February 2026
The low-pressure area has weakened and still persists over the Southwest Bay of Bengal to the south-
east of Sri Lanka.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Trincomalee via Hambantota and Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in
the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-easterly and wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (45-
50) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Negombo to Kankasanthurai via
Puttalam.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Negombo to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam will be fairly rough
at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Matara and Kaluthara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 21 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 21 February 2026
Atmospheric conditions are favorable for thundershowers over most parts of the island and
showery condition is expected to enhance today (21).
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the Northern, North-Central, Eastern, Uva and
Central provinces and in the Hambantota district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m.
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Central, Uva and Sabaragamuwa
provinces and in the Batticaloa, Ampara and Polonnaruwa districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75
mm are likely at some places elsewhere.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle, Matara and Kaluthara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

முல்ழலத்தீவிலிருந்து காங்தகசந்துழற மற்றும் புத்தளம் ஊடாக வகாழும்பு வழையான
கழைதயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகளில் காற்றானது வடகிைக்கு முதல் வடக்கு
வழையான திழசகளிலிருந்து வீசக் கூடும். நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள ஏழனய கடற்பைப்புகளில்
காற்றானது வதன்தமற்கு அல்லது மாறுபட்ட திழசகளிலிருந்து வீசக் கூடும். காற்றின்
தவகமானது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 30-40 கிதலா மீற்றர் வழை காணப்படும் என
எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
கடல் நிழல:
நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள கடற்பைப்புகள் மிதமான அழலயுடன் காணப்படும் என
எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை வபய்யும் தநைங்களில் கடற் பகுதிகளில் அவ்வப்தபாது பலமான
காற்று வீசுவதுடன் அக்கடற் பிைததசங்கள் மிகவும் வகாந்தளிப்பாகவும் காணப்படும்.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 22 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 21 February 2026
Several spell of showers will occur in Northern and Eastern provinces and in Puttalam district.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls
above 75 mm are likely at some places.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle,
Matara and Kaluthara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 22 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 22 February 2026
Due to the low level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka, Showers or
thundershowers will occur at most part of the Island after 1.00 p.m. Heavy falls above 100 mm
are likely at some places.
Showers may occur in Western and North-western provinces and in Mullaittivu district in the
morning too.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces
and in Galle, Matara and Kaluthara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages
caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 22 February 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Mullaittivu via Hambantota, Batticaloa and Trincomalee. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a
few places in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-westerly to northerly in the sea areas from Mullaittivu to Colombo via
Kankasanthurai and Puttalam. Winds will be variable in the other sea areas around the island. Wind
speed will be (20-30) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (40-45) kmph at times in the sea areas
off the coast extending from Matara to Mullaittivu via Hambantota, Batticaloa and Trincomalee.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Matara to Mullaittivu via Hambantota, Batticaloa and
Trincomalee will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

ப த்த மகைவீழ்ச்சி ததரடர்பரை ஆல ரசகை
இயற்கை அைர்த்தம் ததரடர்பரை முன்தைச்சரிக்கை நிக யத்திைரல்,
2026 பெப்ரவரி 23ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 08.30 மணி வகர தசல்லுபடியரகும் வகையில்
2026 பெப்ரவரி 22ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 08.30 மணியில் தவளியிடப்பட்டது.
மத்திய, ஊவர, சப்ரைமுவ, ைிைக்கு மற்றும் வடமத்திய மரைரணங்ைளுக்கும் ைரலி மற்றும்
மரத்தகற மரவட்டங்ைளுக்கும்:
தயவுதசய்து அவதரைமரை இருக்ைவும்!
இ ங்கைகயச் சூைவுள்ள பகுதிைளில்
உருவரைிய ைீழ் வளிமண்ட த் தளம்பல் நிக
ைரரணமரை மத்திய, ஊவர, சப்ரைமுவ, ைிைக்கு
மற்றும் வடமத்திய மரைரணங்ைளிலும் ைரலி
மற்றும் மரத்தகற மரவட்டங்ைளிலும் சி
இடங்ைளில் 100 மி.மீ க்கும் அதிைமரை ப த்த
மகைவீழ்ச்சி எதிர்பரர்க்ைப்படுைின்றது.
எைலவ இடியுடன் கூடிய மகை தபய்யும்
லவகளைளில், ப த்த மகைவீழ்ச்சி, ப த்த
ைரற்று மற்றும் ைடும் மின்ைல்
தரக்ைங்ைளிைரல் ஏற்படக்கூடிய
பரதிப்புைகள குகறத்துக் தைரள்ள
லதகவயரை முன்தைச்சரிக்கை
நடவடிக்கைைகள எடுத்துக் தைரள்ளுமரறு
தபரதுமக்ைள் அறிவுறுத்தப்படுைின்றரர்ைள்.

the Bay of Bengal, northeast of Sri Lanka.

in the sea areas marked on the map below, and the mentioned sea areas may be rough.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and
bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.

කළුතර, ගාල්ල ස මාතර දිස්ත්‍රික්කවල හවරළාබඩ ප්‍රහේශ වල උදෑසන කාලහේදී ද වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
මධ්‍යම ස සබරගමුව පළාාත්වලත් කළුතර, ගාල්ල ස මාතර දිස්ත්‍රික්කවලත් පස්වරු 2.00 න් පසුව ස්ථාන
ස්වල්පයක වැසි හ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක. හමම ප්‍රහේශ වල ඇතැම් ස්ථානවලට මි.මී. 50 ට වැඩි
තරමාකා තද වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
මධ්‍යම, සබරගමුව ස ඌව පළාාත්වලත් අම්පාර ස ම්බන්හතාට දිස්ත්‍රික්කවලත් ඇතැම් ස්ථානවල අළුයම්

ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි සමාග ඇතිවිය හාැකි ත වකා ලිකා තද සුළ වලින් සහා අකුණු මාඟින් සිදු වන්‍ය අන්‍යතුරු අවමා කාර ගැනීමාට

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 23 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 22 February 2026
The prevailing heavy rainy conditions are gradually decreasing as the low-pressure area over the
southwest Bay of Bengal is moving away from the island.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in
Trincomalee district.
Showers may occur in coastal areas in the Kalutara, Galle and Matara district in the morning too.
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Kalutara, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some
places in these areas.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and
in Ampara and Hambantota districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 22 February 2026
The atmospheric disturbance that prevailed over the Bay of Bengal has developed into a low-pressure
area and is currently located to the northeast of Sri Lanka. Under the influence of this system, heavy
showers or thundershowers, Strong wind gust about (50-60) kmph hence sea areas may be rough in
the aforementioned sea areas.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar to
Trincomalee via Kankasanthurai and Mullaittivu. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-westerly in the sea areas around the island. Wind speed will be (20-40) kmph.
State of Sea:
The sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

text:
அறிக்கை இல : 01 TCA/26/02/22/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
தென்மேற்கு வங்காள விாிகுடா ைடற்பரப்புைளுக்கு மேலாை ஒரு குகறந்ெ அழுத்ெப்
பிரமெசம் தொடர்பான ஆமலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்ெம் தொடர்பான முன்தனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்ெினால்,
2026 பெப்ரவாி 22ஆம் ெிைெி பிற்பைல் 1.00 ேணியில் தெளியிடப்பட்டது.
வங்காள விாிகுடா ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் இலங்கையின் ெடக்கு, ைிழக்கு ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும்
கடல் சார் நடெடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ேீனெர்ைளுக்கும் ைடலில் பயணம்
தசய்மொருக்கும்:
ெயவு தசய்து அெொனோை இருக்ைவும்!
வங்காள விாிகுடாவில் நிலவிய ெளிேண்டலத் ெளம்பல் நிகல, ஒரு குகறந்ெ அழுத்ெப் பிரமெசோை
ெிருத்ெியகடந்து, தற்பொது இலங்கைக்கு வடைிழக்ைாை நிகல தைாண்டுள்ளது. இத் தொகுெியின்
தாக்கம் காரணமாக, கீபே உள்ள வரரெடத்தில் குறிக்கப்ெட்டுள்ள ைடற்பரப்புைளில் ெலத்த மரே
அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய மரே பெய்யக் கூடுெதுடன், ேணித்ெியாலத்துக்கு 30-40 ைிமலா ேீற்றர்

The prevailing heavy rainy conditions are gradually decreasing as the low-pressure area over the
southwest Bay of Bengal is moving away from the island.
Tonight:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at most part of the Island. Heavy falls above 100 mm are
likely at some places.
Tomorrow:
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in
Trincomalee district.
Showers may occur in coastal areas in the Kalutara, Galle and Matara district in the morning too.
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Kalutara, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some
places in these areas.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in
Ampara and Hambantota districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 23 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 23 February 2026
The prevailing rainy conditions are expected to reduce from today (23) as the low-pressure area
over the southwest Bay of Bengal moves away from the island.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and
in Trincomalee district.
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Galle, Matara, Rathnapura and
Hambantota districts after 2.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces
and in Ampara and Hambantota districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 23 February 2026
The atmospheric disturbance that prevailed over the Bay of Bengal has developed into a low-
pressure area and is currently located to the northeast of Sri Lanka. Under the influence of this
system, heavy showers or thundershowers, Strong wind gust about (50-60) kmph are possible.
Hence sea areas may be rough in the aforementioned sea areas.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Batticaloa via Kankasanthurai and Trincomalee. Showers may occur at a few places in the
other sea areas around the island.
Winds:
Winds will be North-westerly in the sea areas around the island. Wind speed will be (20-40) kmph.
State of Sea:
The sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

COLOR: Amber
Advisory for the low pressure area over Southwest Bay of Bengal.
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre, Department of Meteorology.
Issued at 1.00 p.m. on 23 January 2026
For fishermen and naval communities engaged in marine activities in
the Bay of Bengal, northeast of Sri Lanka.
PLEASE BE AWARE!
The low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal, to the northeast of Sri Lanka, is moving
northeastwards and is expected to weaken further during the next 24 hours. Under the
influence of this system, heavy showers or thundershowers, Strong wind gust about (50-60)
kmph, may occur in the sea areas marked on the map below, and the mentioned sea areas may
be rough.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and
bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.

2026 පෙබරව රි මාස 23 දින්‍ය ෙ.ව. 2.00 ට නිකුත්කාරන්‍ය ලංදී.

දකුණු පළාහතත් රත්නපුර ස කළුතර දිස්ික්කවලත් පස්වරු 2.00 න් පසුව ස්ථාන ස්වල්පයක වැසි හ ෝ
ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
දිවයිහන් හසසු ප්‍රහේශවල ප්‍රධ්‍ාන වශහයන් වැසි රහිත කාලගුණ තත්ත්වයක් පවතී.
මධ්‍යම, සබරගමුව ස උතුරු-මැද පළාත්වලත් ගාල්ල, මාතර ස කුරුණෑගල දිස්ික්කවලත් ඇතැම්

ගැනීමාට අවශ්‍ පියවර ගේන්‍ය පලංස ජන්‍යත වපගේ කා රුණිකාව ඉල්ලං සිටිනු ලංැපේ.
WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 23 February 2026
Showery condition over the island is expected to reduce from today (23).
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and
Kalutara districts after 2.00 p.m.
Mainly fair weather will prevail over the other areas of the island.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and North-central
provinces and in Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 23 February 2026
The low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal, to the northeast of Sri Lanka, is moving
northeastwards and is expected to weaken further during the next 24 hours. Under the influence
of this system, heavy showers or thundershowers, Strong wind gust about (50-60) kmph are
possible. Hence sea areas may be rough in the aforementioned sea areas.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota during the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-westerly in the sea areas around the island. Wind speed will be (20-40) kmph.
State of Sea:
The sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
நாட்டின் ஏழனய பிைபதசங்களில் பிைதானமாக சீைான வானிழல நிலவும் என
எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
மத்திய, சப்ைகமுவ மற்றும் வடமத்திய மாகாணங்களிலும் காலி, மாத்தழற மற்றும் குருநாகல்
மாவட்டங்களிலும் சில இடங்களில் அதிகாழல பவழளயில் பனிமூட்டமான நிழல
காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை பபய்யும் பவழளகளில் அப் பிைபதசங்களில் தற்காலிகமாக வீசக்
கூடிய பலத்த காற்று மற்றும் மின்னல் தாக்கங்களினால் ஏற்படக்கூடிய பாதிப்புகழள
குழறத்துக்பகாள்ள பதழவயான முன்பனச்சாிக்ழக நடவடிக்ழககழள எடுத்துக்
பகாள்ளுமாறு பபாதுமக்கள் அறிவுறுத்தப்படுகின்றார்கள்.

வானிழல முன்னறிவிப்பு
2026 பெப்ரவரி 23ஆம் திகதி பிற்பகல் 02.00 மணிக்கு பவளியிடப்பட்டது.

பிைபதசமானது வடகிழக்கு ந ரக்கி கர்ந்து, அடுத்த 24 மணி ந ரத்தில் நமலும்

மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 கிபலா மீற்றர் வழையான பவகத்தில் ெலத்த கரற்று வீசக்கூடும்,
அத்துடன் இக் கடற்பைப்புகள் பகாந்தளிப்பாகக் காணப்படும் என எதிர் பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
கடலில் பயணம் பசய்பவாரும் மீனவ சமூகமும் இவ்விடயம் பதாடர்பாக வளிமண்டலவியல்
திழணக்களத்தால் வைங்கப்படும் எதிர்கால முன்னறிவிப்புகள் மற்றும் அறிக்ழககள்
பதாடர்பாக அவதானமாக இருக்குமாறு பவண்டிக் பகாள்ளப்படுகிறீர்கள்.

அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய மழைபயா பபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 24 February 2026
The low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal, to the northeast of Sri Lanka, is moving
northeastwards and is expected to weaken further. Under the influence of this system, heavy
showers or thundershowers, Strong wind gust about (50-60) kmph are possible. Hence sea areas
may be rough in the aforementioned sea areas.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota during the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be North-westerly in the sea areas around the island. Wind speed will be (20-40) kmph.
State of Sea:
The sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 25 FEBRUARY 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 24 February 2026
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura,
Monaragala and Kaluthara districts after 2.00 p.m.
Mainly fair weather will prevail over the other areas of the island.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western and North-
western provinces and in Anuradhapura, Galle, Matara, Monaragala, Mannar and Vavuniya districts
during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

வெப்பநிகலக்ைான எ ிர்வுகூறல் அல்ல. இது ெளிமண்டலெியல் ிகணக்ைளத் ால் அடுத்
நாளுக்ைாைத் யாாிக்ைப்படுெதுடன் பூலைாள எண்சார் ொனிகல எ ிர்வுகூறல் மா ிாித்
ைவுைகளப் பயன்படுத் ி உருொக்ைப்படுைின்றது.
மனி உடலில் வெப்பச் சுட்வடண்ணின் ாக்ைம் லமலுள்ள அட்டெகணயில் ைாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது.
இது சுைா ாை மற்றும் சுல ச மருத்துெ லசகெைள் அகமச்சின் ஆலலாசகனயின் அடிப்பகடயில்
யாாிக்ைப்பட்டுள்ளது.
எடுக்ை லெண்டிய நடெடிக்கைைள்:
லெகலத் ளங்ைளில்: லபாதுமான நீர் அருந்துங்ைள். சாத் ியமான லெகளைளில் நிழலான
பகு ிைளில் ஓய்வெடுங்ைள்.
உள்ளைப் பகு ிைளில்: ெய ானெர்ைகளயும் லநாயாளிைகளயும் ைெனித்துக் வைாள்ளுங்ைள்.

Warm Weather Advisory
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 3.30 p.m. on 06 March 2026, valid for 07 March 2026.
For Sabaragamuwa province and, Colombo, Gampaha, Kurunegala, Anuradhapura,
Vavuniya, Hambanthota and Monaragala districts.
PLEASE BE AWARE
Heat index, the temperature felt on human body is likely to increase up to ‘Caution level’ at
some places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Colombo, Gampaha, Kurunegala,
Anuradhapura, Vavuniya, Hambantota and Monaragala districts.

The Heat Index Forecast is calculated by using relative humidity and maximum temperature
and this is the condition that is felt on your body. This is not the forecast of maximum
temperature. It is generated by the Department of Meteorology for the next day period and
prepared by using global numerical weather prediction model data.
Effect of the heat index on human body is mentioned in the above table and it is prepared on
the advice of the Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medical Services.
ACTION REQUIRED
Job sites: Stay hydrated and takes breaks in the shade as often as possible.
Indoors: Check up on the elderly and the sick.
Vehicles: Never leave children unattended.
Outdoors: Limit strenuous outdoor activities, find shade and stay hydrated.
Dress: Wear lightweight and white or light-colored clothing.
Note:
In addition, please refer to advisories issued by the Disaster Preparedness & Response Division, Ministry
of Health in this regard as well. For further clarifications please contact 011-7446491.

prepared by using global numerical weather prediction model data.

இயற்கை அனர்த் ம் வ ாடர்பான முன்வனச்சாிக்கை பிாிெினால் வெளியிடப்பட்டது
2026 மார்ச் 08ஆம் ிை ி ெகை வசல்லுபடியாகும் ெகையில்
2026 மார்ச் 07ஆம் ிை ி பிற்பைல் 3.30 மணியில் வெளியிடப்பட்டது.
சப்ைைமுெ, ெடலமல் மற்றும் ெடமத் ிய மாைாணங்ைளுக்கும் வைாழும்பு, ைம்பஹா,
ெவுனியா, மன்னார், ஹம்பாந்ல ாட்கட மற்றும் வமானைாைகல மாெட்டங்ைளுக்கும்:
யவு வசய்து அெ ானமாை இருக்ைவும்:
வெப்பச் சுட்வடண், அ ாெது மனி உடலில் உணைப்படும் வெப்பநிகலயானது சப்ைைமுெ,
ெடலமல் மற்றும் ெடமத் ிய மாைாணங்ைளிலும் வைாழும்பு, ைம்பஹா, ெவுனியா, மன்னார்,
ஹம்பாந்ல ாட்கட மற்றும் வமானைாைகல மாெட்டங்ைளிலும் சில இடங்ைளில் ‘எச்சாிக்கை
மட்டம்’ ெகை அ ிைாிக்ைலாம் என எ ிர்பார்க்ைப்படுைின்றது.

சுட்வடண்
27 – 38 சாதாரண நிலை
39 – 45 எச்சாிக்கை அ ிை லநைம் வெயிலில் வெளிப்படுத் லாலும் நடெடிக்கைைளாலும்
ைகளப்பும் லசார்வும் ஏற்படலாம். வ ாடர்ச்சியாை வெயிலில்
நடெடிக்கைைள் லமற்வைாள்ெ ால் வெப்பத் கசப்பிடிப்பு (heat
cramps) ஏற்படலாம்.
46 – 52 ீெிை வெப்பத் கசப்பிடிப்பு (heat cramps) மற்றும் வெப்பத் ால் நீர்
எச்சாிக்கை இழப்புக்கு (heat exhaustion) சாத் ியம் உண்டு. வ ாடர்ச்சியாை
வெயிலில் நடெடிக்கைைள் லமற்வைாள்ெ ால் வெப்பத் ால்
பாாிசொ ம் (heat stroke) ஏற்படக்கூடிய சாத் ியம் உண்டு.

லமல் இழப்புக்கு (heat exhaustion) சாத் ியம் அ ிைளெில் உண்டு.
வ ாடர்ச்சியாை வெயிலில் நடெடிக்கைைள் லமற்வைாள்ெ ால்
வெப்பத் ால் பாாிசொ ம் (heat stroke) ஏற்படலாம்.
வெப்பச் சுட்வடண் என்பது சாாீைப்ப ன் மற்றும் உச்ச வெப்பநிகலகயப் பயன்படுத் ி
ைணிப்பிடப்படுைின்றது. இதுலெ உங்ைள் உடலில் உணைப்படும் நிகலயாகும். இது உச்ச
வெப்பநிகலக்ைான எ ிர்வுகூறல் அல்ல. இது ெளிமண்டலெியல் ிகணக்ைளத் ால் அடுத்
நாளுக்ைாைத் யாாிக்ைப்படுெதுடன் பூலைாள எண்சார் ொனிகல எ ிர்வுகூறல் மா ிாித்
ைவுைகளப் பயன்படுத் ி உருொக்ைப்படுைின்றது.
மனி உடலில் வெப்பச் சுட்வடண்ணின் ாக்ைம் லமலுள்ள அட்டெகணயில் ைாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது.
இது சுைா ாை மற்றும் சுல ச மருத்துெ லசகெைள் அகமச்சின் ஆலலாசகனயின் அடிப்பகடயில்
யாாிக்ைப்பட்டுள்ளது.
எடுக்ை லெண்டிய நடெடிக்கைைள்:
லெகலத் ளங்ைளில்: லபாதுமான நீர் அருந்துங்ைள். சாத் ியமான லெகளைளில் நிழலான
பகு ிைளில் ஓய்வெடுங்ைள்.
உள்ளைப் பகு ிைளில்: ெய ானெர்ைகளயும் லநாயாளிைகளயும் ைெனித்துக் வைாள்ளுங்ைள்.
ொைனங்ைளில்: சிறுெர்ைகள ஒரு லபாதும் ைெனிப்பின்றி ெிட்டுச் வசல்ல லெண்டாம்.
வெளியைப் பகு ிைளில்: அ ிை ைகளப்கப ஏற்படுத்தும் வெளியை நடெடிக்கைைகளக் குகறத்துக்
வைாள்ளுங்ைள். நிழலான பகு ிைளில் இருப்பதுடன் லபாதுமான நீர் அருந்துங்ைள்.

For Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and, Vavuniya and

PLEASE BE AWARE
Heat index, the temperature felt on human body is likely to increase up to ‘Caution level’ at
some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Vavuniya and
Mannar districts.

The Heat Index Forecast is calculated by using relative humidity and maximum temperature
and this is the condition that is felt on your body. This is not the forecast of maximum
temperature. It is generated by the Department of Meteorology for the next day period and
prepared by using global numerical weather prediction model data.
Effect of the heat index on human body is mentioned in the above table and it is prepared on
the advice of the Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medical Services.
ACTION REQUIRED
Job sites: Stay hydrated and takes breaks in the shade as often as possible.
Indoors: Check up on the elderly and the sick.
Vehicles: Never leave children unattended.
Outdoors: Limit strenuous outdoor activities, find shade and stay hydrated.
Dress: Wear lightweight and white or light-colored clothing.
Note:
In addition, please refer to advisories issued by the Disaster Preparedness & Response Division, Ministry
of Health in this regard as well. For further clarifications please contact 011-7446491.

Warm Weather Advisory
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 3.30 p.m. on 10 March 2026, valid for 11 March 2026.
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and North-western provinces and
Monaragala district.
PLEASE BE AWARE
Heat index, the temperature felt on human body is likely to increase up to ‘Caution level’ at
some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and North-western provinces and in
Monaragala district.

The Heat Index Forecast is calculated by using relative humidity and maximum temperature
and this is the condition that is felt on your body. This is not the forecast of maximum
temperature. It is generated by the Department of Meteorology for the next day period and
prepared by using global numerical weather prediction model data.
Effect of the heat index on human body is mentioned in the above table and it is prepared on
the advice of the Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medical Services.
ACTION REQUIRED
Job sites: Stay hydrated and takes breaks in the shade as often as possible.
Indoors: Check up on the elderly and the sick.
Vehicles: Never leave children unattended.
Outdoors: Limit strenuous outdoor activities, find shade and stay hydrated.
Dress: Wear lightweight and white or light-colored clothing.
Note:
In addition, please refer to advisories issued by the Disaster Preparedness & Response Division, Ministry
of Health in this regard as well. For further clarifications please contact 011-7446491.

இயற்கை அனர்த் ம் வ ாடர்பான முன்வனச்சாிக்கை பிாிெினால் வெளியிடப்பட்டது
2026 மார்ச் 11ஆம் ிை ி ெகை வசல்லுபடியாகும் ெகையில்
2026 மார்ச் 10ஆம் ிை ி பிற்பைல் 3.30 மணியில் வெளியிடப்பட்டது.
லமல், சப்ைைமுெ, வ ன் மற்றும் ெடலமல் மாைாணங்ைளுக்கும் வமானைாைகல
மாெட்டத் ிற்கும்:
யவு வசய்து அெ ானமாை இருக்ைவும்:
வெப்பச் சுட்வடண், அ ாெது மனி உடலில் உணைப்படும் வெப்பநிகலயானது லமல், சப்ைைமுெ,
வ ன் மற்றும் ெடலமல் மாைாணங்ைளிலும் வமானைாைகல மாெட்டத் ிலும் சில இடங்ைளில்
‘எச்சாிக்கை மட்டம்’ ெகை அ ிைாிக்ைலாம் என எ ிர்பார்க்ைப்படுைின்றது.

வெப்பச் எச்சாிக்கை மட்டம்
சுட்வடண்
27 – 38 சாதாரண நிலை
39 – 45 எச்சாிக்கை அ ிை லநைம் வெயிலில் வெளிப்படுத் லாலும் நடெடிக்கைைளாலும்
ைகளப்பும் லசார்வும் ஏற்படலாம். வ ாடர்ச்சியாை வெயிலில்
நடெடிக்கைைள் லமற்வைாள்ெ ால் வெப்பத் கசப்பிடிப்பு (heat
cramps) ஏற்படலாம்.
46 – 52 ீெிை வெப்பத் கசப்பிடிப்பு (heat cramps) மற்றும் வெப்பத் ால் நீர்
எச்சாிக்கை இழப்புக்கு (heat exhaustion) சாத் ியம் உண்டு. வ ாடர்ச்சியாை
வெயிலில் நடெடிக்கைைள் லமற்வைாள்ெ ால் வெப்பத் ால்
பாாிசொ ம் (heat stroke) ஏற்படக்கூடிய சாத் ியம் உண்டு.
52 க்கு அபாயம் வெப்பத் கசப்பிடிப்பு (heat cramps) மற்றும் வெப்பத் ால் நீர்
லமல் இழப்புக்கு (heat exhaustion) சாத் ியம் அ ிைளெில் உண்டு.
வ ாடர்ச்சியாை வெயிலில் நடெடிக்கைைள் லமற்வைாள்ெ ால்
வெப்பத் ால் பாாிசொ ம் (heat stroke) ஏற்படலாம்.
வெப்பச் சுட்வடண் என்பது சாாீைப்ப ன் மற்றும் உச்ச வெப்பநிகலகயப் பயன்படுத் ி
ைணிப்பிடப்படுைின்றது. இதுலெ உங்ைள் உடலில் உணைப்படும் நிகலயாகும். இது உச்ச
வெப்பநிகலக்ைான எ ிர்வுகூறல் அல்ல. இது ெளிமண்டலெியல் ிகணக்ைளத் ால் அடுத்
நாளுக்ைாைத் யாாிக்ைப்படுெதுடன் பூலைாள எண்சார் ொனிகல எ ிர்வுகூறல் மா ிாித்
ைவுைகளப் பயன்படுத் ி உருொக்ைப்படுைின்றது.
மனி உடலில் வெப்பச் சுட்வடண்ணின் ாக்ைம் லமலுள்ள அட்டெகணயில் ைாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது.
இது சுைா ாை மற்றும் சுல ச மருத்துெ லசகெைள் அகமச்சின் ஆலலாசகனயின் அடிப்பகடயில்
யாாிக்ைப்பட்டுள்ளது.
எடுக்ை லெண்டிய நடெடிக்கைைள்:
லெகலத் ளங்ைளில்: லபாதுமான நீர் அருந்துங்ைள். சாத் ியமான லெகளைளில் நிழலான
பகு ிைளில் ஓய்வெடுங்ைள்.
உள்ளைப் பகு ிைளில்: ெய ானெர்ைகளயும் லநாயாளிைகளயும் ைெனித்துக் வைாள்ளுங்ைள்.
ொைனங்ைளில்: சிறுெர்ைகள ஒரு லபாதும் ைெனிப்பின்றி ெிட்டுச் வசல்ல லெண்டாம்.
வெளியைப் பகு ிைளில்: அ ிை ைகளப்கப ஏற்படுத்தும் வெளியை நடெடிக்கைைகளக் குகறத்துக்
வைாள்ளுங்ைள். நிழலான பகு ிைளில் இருப்பதுடன் லபாதுமான நீர் அருந்துங்ைள்.
ஆகட: இலலசான, வெண்ணிற அல்லது வெளிர் நிற ஆகடைகள அணியுங்ைள்

அடுத்த 24 மணித்தியாலத்துக்கான, நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள கடற் பைப்பிற்கான
வானிழல முன்னறிவிப்பு
2026 மார்ச் 12ஆம் திகதி பிற்பகல் 02.00 மணிக்கு பவளியிடப்பட்டது.
மழை நிழலழம:
பகாழும்பிலிருந்து காலி ஊடாக மாத்தழற வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
கடற்பைப்புகளில் பல இடங்களில் மாழலயில் அல்லது இைவில் மழைமயா அல்லது இடியுடன்
கூடிய மழைமயா பபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
காற்று :
நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள கடற்பைப்புகளில் காற்றானது கிைக்கு முதல் வடகிைக்கு வழையான
திழசகளிலிருந்து வீசக் கூடும். காற்றின் மவகமானது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 20-30 கிமலா
மீற்றர் வழை காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
மாத்தழறயிலிருந்து பபாத்துவில் வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
கடற்பைப்புகளில் காற்றின் மவகமானது அவ்வப்மபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 40 கிமலா மீற்றர்
வழை அதிகாிக்கக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
கடல் நிழல:
மாத்தழறயிலிருந்து பபாத்துவில் வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகள்
அவ்வப்மபாது மிதமான அழலயுடன் காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள ஏழனய கடற்பைப்புகள் சாதாைண அழலயுடன் காணப்படும் என
எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை பபய்யும் மநைங்களில் கடற் பகுதிகளில் அவ்வப்மபாது பலமான காற்று
வீசுவதுடன் அக்கடற் பிைமதசங்கள் மிகவும் பகாந்தளிப்பாகவும் காணப்படும்.
