Winds will be South-westerly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at
times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be moderate.
The swell waves (about 2.0 – 2.5 m) height (this is not for land area) may increase in the sea areas off the coast
extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 14 May 2026.
The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. This system is expected to
move away from Sri Lanka during the next 48 hours according to the latest weather analysis
based on May 14th morning.
Cloudy skies are expected over most parts of the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-
western and Northern provinces and in Anuradhapura, Galle and Matara districts.
Heavy showers above 100mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Puttalam, Galle and Matara districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at some places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00 pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 May 2026.
The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. This system is expected to
move away from Sri Lanka during the next 36 hours.
Cloudy skies are expected over most parts of the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western
and Northern provinces and in Anuradhapura, Galle and Matara districts.
Very heavy showers about 150mm are likely at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-
western provinces.
Heavy showers above 100mm are likely at some places in and in Galle and Matara districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00 pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 May 2026
The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. This system is expected to move
away from Sri Lanka during the next 36 hours.
Under the influence of this system, wind speed and rainy conditions over the sea areas around the island may
increase in the coming days.
The naval and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins issued by the
Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas around the island.
Winds:
Winds will be South-westerly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at
times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be moderate.
The swell waves (about 2.0 – 2.5 m) height (this is not for land area) may increase in the sea areas off the coast
extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 கிதலா மீற்றர் வழை அதிகாிக்கக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
காணப்படுகின்றது.
கடல் நிழல:
திருதகாணமழலயிலிருந்து காங்தகசந்துழற, புத்தளம், வகாழும்பு, காலி மற்றும்

படுகின்றது. நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள ஏழனய கடற்பைப்புகள் மிதமான அழலயுடன்
காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது.

text:
බහු දින යාත්‍රා සඳහා කාලගුණ අනාවැකිය
උතුරු අක්ාාංශ 20 ත් දකුණු අක්ාාංශ 10 ත් සහ නැගෙනහිර ගේශාාංශ 60 ත් 100 ත් අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ සඳහා
(2026 මැයි මස 15 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
ශ්‍රී ලාංකාවට ඊසාන ගදසින් පිහිටා ඇති අඩු පීඩන කලාෙය තවදුරටත් ෙවතී. එම ෙේධතිය, ඉදිරි ෙැය 36 තුල ශ්‍රී
ලාංකාගවන් ඉවතට ෙමන් කරනු ඇතැයි අගේක්ා ගකගේ.
ගමම ෙේධතිගේ බලෙෑම ගහතුේ ගවන් ඉදිරි දිනවලදී දිවයින වටාවන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල සුළගේ ගේෙය සහ වැසි තත්ත්වය වැඩිවිය
හැක.
බම් සම් න්ධබයන් කොලගුණ විෙයො බෙපොර්තබම්න්ුව විසින් නිකුත් කරනු ල න ඉදිරි අනොවැකි ස නිබේෙන පිළි ඳව
අවධොනබයන් පසුවන බලස ධීවර ස නොවුක ප්‍රජොවබෙන් ඉල්ලො සිටිනු ලැබේ.
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
දිවයින වටො වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල විටින් විට වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේෙය පැ.කි.මී. (25-35) පමණ බේ. ත්‍රිකුණාමලය සිට කන්කසන්තුගේ, පුත්තලම,
ගකාළඹ, ොල්ල සහ හේබන්ගතාට හරහා ගොතුවිල් දකවා ගවරළට ඔේගබන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල සුළගේ ගේෙය විටින් විට
ෙැ.කි.මී. (50-60) ෙමණ දකවා ඉහළ යා හැක.
මුහුගේ සේවභාවය:
ත්‍රිකුණාමලය සිට කන්කසන්තුගේ, පුත්තලම, ගකාළඹ, ොල්ල සහ හේබන්ගතාට හරහා ගොතුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔේබ න් වන
මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට රළු බේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ මඳ වශබයන් රළු විය ැක.
පුත්තලම සිට ගකාළඹ, ොල්ල සහ හේබන්ගතාට හරහා ගොතුවිල් දකවා ගවරළට ඔේගබන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල මුහුදු රළ උස
මීටේ (2.0 – 2.5) ක ෙමණ ඉහළ යාගේ හැකියාවක ෙවතී. (බමය බෙොඩබිමට එන රළ උස බනොබේ).
ගිගුරුේ සහිත වැසි ඇති වන විට එම මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල තාවකාලිකව තද සුළාං ඇති විය හැකි අතර එවිට එම මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.
ගබාංොල ගබාකක මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශය
ශ්‍රී ලාංකාවට ඊසාන ගදසින් පිහිටා ඇති අඩු පීඩන කලාෙය තවදුරටත් ෙවතී. . ඉදිරි ෙැය 36 තුල එම ෙේධතිය ශ්‍රී
ලාංකාගවන් ඉවතට ෙමන් කරනු ඇතැයි අගේක්ා ගකගේ. ගමම ෙේධතිගේ බලෙෑම ගහේතුගවන් ඉදිරි දිනවලදී
දිවයින වටාවන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල සුළගේ ගේෙය සහ වැසි තත්ත්වය වැඩිවිය හැක.
ගමම ෙේධතිය ගහේතුගවන් ඉදිරි දිනවලදී ගබාංොල ගබාකක ෙැඹුරු මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල තද සුළාං සහ තද වැසි ඇතිවිය
හැකි අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ රළු වීගේ හැකියාවක ෙවතී.
කාලගුණ විදයා ගදොේතගේන්තුව මගින් ගේ සේබන්ධව නිකුත් කරන ඉදිරි නිගේදන පිළිබඳ සිය අවධානය ගයාමු
කරන ගලස ද ධීවර හා නාවික ප්‍රජාවගෙන් ඉල්ලා සිටිනු ලැගේ.
කාලගුණික තත්ත්වය:

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 16 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 15 May 2026
According to the today’s (May 15th) latest weather analysis, the low-pressure area located
northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. The Department of Meteorology is continuously
monitoring the behavior, development and path of the system.
Due to the influence of the above system, Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and
cloudy skies are expected in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Fairly heavy showers above 75 mm are likely at some
places in these areas.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 15 May 2026
The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist.
Under the influence of this system, wind speed and rainy conditions over the sea areas around the
island may increase. The naval and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future
forecasts and bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mullaitivu
to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and Colombo. Showers or thundershowers will occur at several
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be South-westerly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via
Kankasanthurai, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be
moderate.
The swell waves (about 2.0 – 2.5 m) height (this is not for land area) may increase in the sea areas
off the coast extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

இலங்கைகைச் சூழவுள்ள பகுதிைளில் குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசம் ததொடர்பொன
ஆதலொசகன:
இைற்கை அனர்த்தம் ததொடர்பொன முன்தனச்சொிக்கை நிகலைத்தினொல்,
2026 மே 15ஆம் திைதி பிற்பைல் 3.00 மணிைில் தெளிைிடப்பட்டது.
தைவு தசய்து அெதொனமொை இருக்ைவும்!
இன்று, மே 15ஆம் திைதி நிலவரத்தின் அடிப்படையிலான சேீபத்திய வானிடல பகுப்பாய்வின்படி,
நொட்டிற்கு ெடைிழக்ைொை நிகல தைொண்டுள்ள குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசம் ததொடர்ந்தும்
ைொணப்படுைின்றது. எனதெ, நொட்கடச் சூழவுள்ள பகுதிைளில் தற்தபொது நிலவும் மகழ
நிகலகமயும் ைொற்று நிகலகமயும் தமலும் ததொடரும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகிறது.
அத்துைன், நொட்கடச் சூழவுள்ள ஆழம் கூடிை மற்றும் ஆழம் குகறந்த ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் ெங்ைொள

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 15 May 2026.
According to the today’s (May 15th) latest weather analysis, the low-pressure area located northeast
of the Sri Lanka, still persist. The Department of Meteorology is continuously monitoring the
behavior, development and path of the system.
Tonight:
Due to the influence of the above system, Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western,
Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern provinces and in Anuradhapura, Galle and
Matara districts. Heavy showers above 100mm are likely at some places.
Tomorrow:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and cloudy skies are expected in Western,
Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Fairly heavy showers above 75 mm are likely at some places in these areas.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 16 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 16 May 2026.
According to the today’s (May 15th) latest we ather analysis, the low-pressure area located
northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. The Department of Meteorology is continuously
monitoring the behavior, development and path of the system.
Due to the influence of the above system, Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and
cloudy skies are expected in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Fairly heavy showers about 75 mm are likely at some
places in these areas.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00
pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 16 May 2026
The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist.
Under the influence of this system, wind speed and rainy conditions is continue over the sea areas
around the island . The naval and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future
forecasts and bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mullaitivu
to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and Colombo. Showers or thundershowers will occur at several
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be South-westerly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via
Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be moderate.
The swell waves (about 2.0 – 2.5 m) height (this is not for land area) may increase in the sea areas
off the coast extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

text:
බහු දින යාත්‍රා සඳහා කාලගුණ අනාවැකිය
උතුරු අක්ාාංශ 20 ත් දකුණු අක්ාාංශ 10 ත් සහ නැගෙනහිර ගේශාාංශ 60 ත් 100 ත් අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ සඳහා
(2026 මැයි මස 16 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
ශ්‍රී ලාංකාවට ඊසාන ගදසින් පිහිටා ඇති අඩු පීඩන කලාෙය තවදුරටත් ෙවතී.
ගමම ෙේධතිගේ බලෙෑම ගහේතුගවන් දිවයින වටාවන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල සුළෙ සහ වැසි තත්ත්වය තවදුරටත් ෙවතී. ගේ
සේබන්ධගයන් කාලගුණ විදයා ගදොර්තගේන්තුව විසින් නිකුත් කරනු ලබන ඉදිරි අනාවැකි සහ නිගේදන පිළිබඳව
අවධානගයන් ෙසුවන ගලස ධීවර සහ නාවුක ප්‍රජාවගෙන් ඉල්ලා සිටිනු ලැගේ.
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
මුලතිව් සිට කන්කසන්ුරය, පුත්තලම සහ කකොළඹ හරහො ගොල්ල දක්වො කවරළට ඔබ්කෙන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රකේශවල විටින්
විට වැසි කහෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති කව්. දිවයින වටො වන අකනකුත් ප්‍රකේශවල සවස් කොලකේ කහෝ රොත්‍රී කොලකේ
තැනින් තැන වැසි කහෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති කව්.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 16 May 2026
The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. Under the influence of this
system, wind speed and rainy conditions over the sea areas around the island may increase. The
naval and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins issued
by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mullaittivu
to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and Colombo. Showers or thundershowers will occur at several
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-55)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

text:
அறிக்கை இல : 06 TCA/26/05/16/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
இலங்கைகைச் சூழவுள்ள பகுதிைளில் குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசம் ததொடர்பொன
ஆதலொசகன:
இைற்கை அனர்த்தம் ததொடர்பொன முன்தனச்சொிக்கை நிகலைத்தினொல்,
2026 மே 16ஆம் திைதி பிற்பைல் 3.00 மணிைில் தெளிைிடப்பட்டது.
தைவு தசய்து அெதொனமொை இருக்ைவும்!
இன்று, மே 16ஆம் திைதி நிலவரத்தின் அடிப்படையிலான சேீபத்திய வானிடல பகுப்பாய்வின்படி,
நொட்டிற்கு ெடைிழக்ைொை நிகல தைொண்டுள்ள குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசம் ததொடர்ந்தும்
ைொணப்படுைின்றது. எனதெ, நொட்கடச் சூழவுள்ள பகுதிைளில் தற்தபொது நிலவும் மகழ
நிகலகமயும் ைொற்று நிகலகமயும் தமலும் ததொடரும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகிறது.
அத்துைன், நொட்கடச் சூழவுள்ள ஆழம் கூடிை மற்றும் ஆழம் குகறந்த ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் ெங்ைொள
ெிொிகுடொெின் ஆழம் கூடிை ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் பலமொன ைொற்று வீசுெதுடன் அக்ைடற்
பிரததசங்ைள் தைொந்தளிப்பொைவும் ைொணப்படும்.

ததன்தமற்கு ெிொிகுடொ ெிொிகுடொெில் குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசத்தின் அடேவிைம்

Advisory for the low pressure area in the vicinity of Sri Lanka.
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre, Department of Meteorology.
Issued at 3.00 p.m. on 16 May 2026
PLEASE BE AWARE!
According to the today’s (May 16th) latest weather analysis, the low-pressure area located
northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. Therefore, the prevailing showery and windy conditions
around the island are expected to continue.
Further, strong winds and rough seas can be expected over the deep and shallow sea areas
around the island, as well as over the deep-sea areas of the Bay of Bengal.

The low-pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. The Department of
Meteorology is continuously monitoring the behavior, development and path of the system.
Due to the influence of the above system, Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and
cloudy skies are expected in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Fairly heavy showers about 75 mm are likely at some

Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00 pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 17 May 2026.
The low-pressure area located to the north of Sri Lanka is gradually weakening.
Due to the influence of the above system, Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and
cloudy skies are expected in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces and in
Polonnaruwa district after 1.00 pm.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 18 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 17 May 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and cloudy skies are expected in Western,
Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Hambantota district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 17 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Hambantota via Puttalam, Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur
at several places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-55)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,

ஊவா மற்றும் கிைக்கு மாகாணங்களில் சில இடங்களில் பி.ப. 1.00 மணிக்குப் பின்னர்

மத்திய மழலநாட்டின் மமற்கு சாிவுப் பகுதிகளிலும் வடக்கு, வடமத்திய மற்றும் வடமமல்

30-40 கிமலா மீற்றர் வழையான மவகத்தில் ஓைளவு பலத்த காற்று வீசக் கூடும் என
எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை பபய்யும் மவழளகளில் அப் பிைமதசங்களில் தற்காலிகமாக வீசக்

காங்மகசந்துழறயிலிருந்து புத்தளம், பகாழும்பு மற்றும் காலி ஊடாக ஹம்பாந்மதாட்ழட
வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகளில் அவ்வப்மபாது மழைமயா
அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய மழைமயா பபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது. நாட்ழடச்
சூைவுள்ள ஏழனய கடற்பைப்புகளில் பல இடங்களில் மாழலயில் அல்லது இைவில் மழைமயா
அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய மழைமயா பபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
காற்று :
நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள கடற்பைப்புகளில் காற்றானது பதன்மமற்குத் திழசயிலிருந்து வீசக் கூடும்.
காற்றின் மவகமானது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 25-35 கிமலா மீற்றர் வழை காணப்படும் என
எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது. காங்மகசந்துழறயிலிருந்து புத்தளம், பகாழும்பு, காலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்மதாட்ழட ஊடாக பபாத்துவில் வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
கடற்பைப்புகளில் காற்றின் மவகமானது அவ்வப்மபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-55 கிமலா
மீற்றர் வழை அதிகாிக்கக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
கடல் நிழல:
காங்மகசந்துழறயிலிருந்து புத்தளம், பகாழும்பு, காலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்மதாட்ழட ஊடாக
பபாத்துவில் வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகள் அவ்வப்மபாது
பகாந்தளிப்பாகக் காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது. நாட்ழடச் சூைவுள்ள ஏழனய
கடற்பைப்புகள் மிதமான அழலயுடன் காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது.

கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது (இது கழைக்கு வரும் அழலகளின் உயைம் அல்ல).

வானிகல அறிக்கை: இலங்கைக்கு வடக்ைாை குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசம்:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் ததாடர்பான முன்தனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 மே 17ஆம் திைதி பிற்பைல் 3.00 மணியில் தவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ஆழம் கூடிய வங்காள விாிகுடா ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் நாட்கடச் சூழவுள்ள ஆழம் கூடிய
மற்றும் ஆழம் குகறந்த ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் கடல் ைார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும்
மீனவர்ைளுக்கும் ைடலில் பயணம் தசய்தவாருக்கும்:
இன்று, மே 17ஆம் திைதி நிலவரத்தின் அடிப்பசடயிலான ைேீபத்திய வானிசல பகுப்பாய்வின்படி,
இலங்கைக்கு வடக்ைாை நிகல தைாண்டிருந்த குகறந்த அழுத்தப் பிரததசம் தற்தபாது பலவீனம்
அகடந்துள்ளது. எனதவ, ஆழம் கூடிய வங்ைாள விாிகுடா ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் நாட்கடச் சூழவுள்ள
ஆழம் கூடிய மற்றும் ஆழம் குகறந்த ைடற்பரப்புைளிலும் அதன் தாக்ைம் படிப்படியாைக்
குகறவகடைின்றது.
இதுதவ இத் ததாகுதி ததாடர்பான இறுதி அறிக்கையாகும்.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 17 May 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times and cloudy skies are expected in Western,
Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Hambantota district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 18 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 18 May 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western
and Northern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces and in
Polonnaruwa district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Hambantota district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Hambantota via Puttalam, Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur
at several places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be
moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Puttalam
to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

குழறத்துக்தகாள்ள லதழவயான முன்தனச்சாிக்ழக
நடவடிக்ழககழள எடுத்துக் தகாள்ளுமாறு தபாதுமக்கள்
அறிவுறுத்தப்படுகின்றார்கள்.
எடுக்க லவண்டிய நடவடிக்ழககள்:
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை தபய்யும் லவழளகளில் தபாதுமக்கள்
பின்வரும் அறிவுழைகழளப் பின்பற்றுமாறு வளிமண்டலவியல் திழணக்களம் ஆலலாசழன
வைங்குகின்றது.
• உள்ளகப் பகுதிகளில் புகலிடம் லதடுங்கள். மைங்களின் கீழ் ஒருலபாதும் நிற்க லவண்டாம்.
• இடி முைக்கத்தின் லபாது தநல்வயல்கள், லதயிழலத் லதாட்டங்கள், திறந்த நீர்நிழலகள்
லபான்றவற்ழறத் தவிர்த்துக் தகாள்ளவும்.
• இடி முைக்கத்தின் லபாது கம்பித்ததாடர்புள்ள ததாழலலபசி மற்றும் மின்னிழணப்பிலுள்ள மின்
உபகைணங்கழளப் பயன்படுத்துவழதத் தவிர்த்துக் தகாள்ளவும்.

Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon 18 May 2026 valid for the period until 11.30 p.m. 18 May 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, Uva and Eastern provinces and
Kurunegala district
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
Thundershowers accompanied with
severe lightning are likely to occur at
some places in Western,
Sabaragamuwa, Uva and Eastern
provinces and in Kurunegala district
after 1.00 p.m.
There may be temporary localized
strong winds during thundershowers.
General public is kindly requested to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology
advises that people should:
• Seek shelter, preferably indoors and
never under trees.
• Avoid open areas such as paddy
fields, tea plantations and open water bodies during thunderstorms.
• Avoid using wired telephones and connected electric appliances during thunderstorms.
• Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
• Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
• For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 19 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 18 May 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western
and provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura and Hambanthota
districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces and in
Polonnaruwa district after 2.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Hambantota district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 18 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Hambantota via Puttalam, Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur
at a few places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar and
from Pottuvil to Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle and from Kankasanthurai to
Trincomalee.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island can be
moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar
to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.

western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces

districts.

central hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Hambantota district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

காணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, moderate: 25-50, Fairly Heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.
වර්ෂාපතනය(මි.මී) : සිහින් වැසි: 00-12.5, සිහින් හ ෝ මද වැසි: 12.5-25, මද වැසි: 25-50, තරමක් තද වැසි: 50 -100,
තද වැසි:100 – 150, ඉතා තද වැසි: 150 හ ෝ ඊට වැඩි
மழைவீழ்ச்சி அளவு (மி.மீ): சிறிதளவு: 00-12.5, சிறிதளவிலிருந்து மிதமானது வழை: 12.5-25, மிதமானது: 25-50,
ஓைளவு பலத்த மழை: 50 -100, பலத்த மழை: 100 – 150, மிகப் பலத்த மழை: 150 க்கும் அதிகமானது

மன்னாாிலிருந்து புத்தளம், வகாழும்பு, காலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்மதாட்ழட ஊடாக
வபாத்துவில் வழையான கழைமயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட கடற்பைப்புகளில் கடல்
அழலகள் 2.0 – 2.5 மீற்றர் உயைம் வழை மமவலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
காணப்படுகின்றது (இது கழைக்கு வரும் அழலகளின் உயைம் அல்ல).
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை வபய்யும் மநைங்களில் கடற் பகுதிகளில் அவ்வப்மபாது பலமான
காற்று வீசுவதுடன் அக்கடற் பிைமதசங்கள் மிகவும் வகாந்தளிப்பாகவும் காணப்படும்.

description: Weather forecast for multi-day boats for the sea areas
text:
බහු දින යාත්‍රා සඳහා කාලගුණ අනාවැකිය
උතුරු අක්ාාංශ 20 ත් දකුණු අක්ාාංශ 10 ත් සහ නැගෙනහිර ගේශාාංශ 60 ත් 100 ත් අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ සඳහා
(2026 මැයි මස 19 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල තැනින්
තැන වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සවස් කොලබේ බ ෝ රොත්‍රී
කොලබේ දී ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේගය පැ.කි.මී. (30-40) පමණ බේ. කන්කසන්ුරය සිට මන්නොරම
ර ො පුත්තලම ෙක්වො ස ම් න්බතොට සිට බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ
බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. (50-60) ෙමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක. පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො
ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො ස කන්කසන්ුරය සිට ත්‍රිකුණොමලය ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල
සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. 50 ෙමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක.
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
ත්‍රිකුණොමලය සිට කන්කසන්ුරය, පුත්තලම, බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො
බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ විටින් විට රළු ගේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ මඳ වශබයන් රළු
විය ැක.
මන්නොරම සිට පුත්තලම, බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන
මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල මුහුදු රළ උස මීටර් (2.0 – 2.5) ක් පමණ ඉ ළ යොබම් ැකියොවක් පවතී. (බමය බගොඩබිමට
එන රළ උස බනොබේ).
ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති වන විට එම මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල තාවකාලිකව තද සුළාං ඇති විය හැකි අතර එවිට එම මුහුදු
ප්‍රගේශ තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.
ගබාංොල ගබාකක මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශය
කාලගුණික තත්ත්වය:
06N - 17N, 95E-100E : බ ොබ ෝ ප්‍රබේශවල වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
05N - 15N, 90E-95E : තැනින් තැන වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
සුළාං තත්ත්වය:
05N -20N, 80E-90E : නිරිත බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. (50-60) ෙක්වො.
05N -20N, 90E-100E : නිරිත සිට ස්නොහිර ෙක්වො වන දිශොවලින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. 50 ෙක්වො.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : නිරිත බෙසින් බ ෝ නිශ්ිත දිශොවකින් බතොරව / පැ.කි.මී. (25-35).
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
05N -20N, 80E-90E : තරමක් රළු, විටින් විට රළු.
05N -20N, 90E-100E : මෙ වශබයන් රළු; විටින් විට තරමක් රළු.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : මෙ වශබයන් රළු.

කාලගුණික තත්ත්වය:
EQ - 10N, 60E-70E : බ ොබ ෝ ප්‍රබේශවල වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
05N-15N, 70E-77E : බ ොබ ෝ ප්‍රබේශවල වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : සථ් ොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
සුළාං තත්ත්වය:
03N-10N, 60E-80E : ස්නොහිර සිට නිරිත ෙක්වො වන දිශොවලින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. (50-55)
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : නිරිත සිට වයඹ ෙක්වො වන දිශොවලින් / පැ.කි.මී. (20-40).

2026 மே 19ஆம் திகதி பிற்பகல் 11.30 மணி வழையான காலப்பகுதிக்காக,

ஊவா மாகாணத்திற்கும் மட்டக்களப்பு மற்றும் அம்பாழற மாவட்டங்களுக்கும்:
தயவுதசய்து அவதானமாக இருக்கவும்:
ஊவா மாகாணத்திலும் மட்டக்களப்பு மற்றும் அம்பாழற

Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.30 p.m. 19 May 2026 valid for the period until 11.30 p.m. 19 May 2026
For Uva province and Batticaloa and Ampara districts
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
Thundershowers accompanied with
severe lightning are likely to occur at
some places in Uva province and in
Batticaloa and Ampara districts after
2.00 p.m.
There may be temporary localized
strong winds during thundershowers.
General public is kindly requested to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology
advises that people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and
never under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy
fields, tea plantations and open
water bodies during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 19 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai
Mannar, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai Mannar,
Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island can be moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar
to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 27 May 2026.
Th e
South-west monsoon has established over the island. The prevailing showery condition over the
south western parts of the island is expected to continue.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are
likely at some places in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 20 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 20 May 2026.
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm
are likely at some places in the above areas.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura and Hambantota
districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa district after 2.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 20 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via
Kankasanthurai, Mannar, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Mannar,
Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island can be moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar
to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

தடழவகள் மழை வபய்யும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது.

text:

(2026 මැයි මස 20 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 21 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 20 May 2026
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places
in the above areas.
Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa district after 2.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 20 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar
and from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. The wind speed may increase to about 50 kmph at times
in the sea areas off the coast from Kankasanthurai to Batticaloa via Trincomalee and from Colombo to
Galle.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar and from Galle to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The sea areas off the coast from Kankasanthurai to
Batticaloa via Trincomalee and from Colombo to Galle will be fairly rough at times. The other sea areas
around the island can be moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar
to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.

Batticaloa district after 2.00 pm.

central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces.

by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 21 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 21 May 2026.
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places
in the above areas.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 2.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 21 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar
and from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. The wind speed may increase to about 50 kmph at times
in the sea areas off the coast from Kankasanthurai to Batticaloa via Trincomalee and from Colombo to
Galle.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar and from Galle to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The sea areas off the coast from Kankasanthurai to
Batticaloa via Trincomalee and from Colombo to Galle will be fairly rough at times. The other sea areas
around the island can be moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.0 - 2.5m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar
to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 22 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 21 May 2026
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places
in these areas.
A few showers will occur in Northern province and in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 2.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (35-45) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Issued by Forecasting Division, National Meteorological Centre
WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 21 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar
and from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. The wind speed may increase to about 50 kmph at times
in the sea areas off the coast from Kankasanthurai to Batticaloa via Trincomalee and from Colombo to
Galle.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar and from Galle to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The sea areas off the coast from Kankasanthurai to
Batticaloa via Trincomalee and from Colombo to Galle will be fairly rough at times. The other sea areas
around the island can be moderate.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

மதசிய வளிமண்டலவியல் நிழலயத்தின் முன்னறிவிப்புப் பிாிவால் பவளியிடப்பட்டது.

மமல், சப்ைகமுவ மற்றும் வடமமல் மாகாணங்களிலும் காலி, மாத்தழற, கண்டி மற்றும்
நுவபைலியா மாவட்டங்களிலும் அவ்வப்மபாது மழைமயா அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய
மழைமயா பபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது. இந்தப் பிைமதசங்களில் சில

(2026 මැයි මස 22 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල තැනින් තැන
වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සවස් කොලබේ බ ෝ රොත්‍රී කොලබේ දී
ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේගය පැ.කි.මී. (30-40) පමණ බේ. මඩකළපුව සිට ත්‍රිකුණොමලය,
කන්කසන්ුරය, මන්නොරම, පුත්තලම, බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට
ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. (50-60) ෙමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක.
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
මඩකළපුව සිට ත්‍රිකුණොමලය, කන්කසන්ුරය, මන්නොරම, පුත්තලම, බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො
බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට රළු ගේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ මඳ
වශබයන් රළු විය ැක.
මන්නොරම සිට පුත්තලම, බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු
ප්‍රබේශවල මුහුදු රළ උස මීටර් (2.0 – 3.0) ක් පමණ ඉ ළ යොබම් ැකියොවක් පවතී. (බමය බගොඩබිමට එන රළ උස
බනොබේ).

05N - 17N, 88E-100E : බ ොබ ෝ ප්‍රබේශවල වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.

බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
සුළාං තත්ත්වය:

02N -10N, 87E-100E : නිරිත සිට ස්නොහිර ෙක්වො වන දිශොවලින් / පැ.කි.මී. (25-35); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. 50 ෙක්වො.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 23 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 22 May 2026
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts.
A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
districts after 2.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (35-45) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (55-60) kmph
at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Galle
to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to (50-55) kmph at times in the other sea areas
around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Galle to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 23 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 23 May 2026.
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle and Matara districts.
A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

text:

(2026 මැයි මස 23 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල තැනින් තැන වැසි
බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සවස් කොලබේ බ ෝ රොත්‍රී කොලබේ දී ස්ථොන
ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේගය පැ.කි.මී. (30-40) පමණ බේ. පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස
ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොතුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. (50-
60) පමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. 50 පමණ
ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක.
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොතුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට
රළු ගේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ තරමක් රළු බේ.
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොතුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල මුහුදු
රළ උස මීටර් (2.0 – 3.0) ක් පමණ ඉ ළ යොබම් ැකියොවක් පවතී. (බමය බගොඩබිමට එන රළ උස බනොබේ).

තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 23 May 2026.
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Heavy falls about 100 mm are
likely at some places.
A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 24 May 2026.
South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are
likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Mainly fair weather will prevail over the rest of the island.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 24 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other sea areas
around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 25 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 24 May 2026
Southwest Monsoon is gradually establishing across the island, an increase in rainfall over the
southwestern parts of the island is expected during the next few days.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are
likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura and Mannar districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other sea areas
around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

text:

උතුරු අක්ාාංශ 20 ත් දකුණු අක්ාාංශ 10 ත් සහ නැගෙනහිර ගේශාාංශ 60 ත් 100 ත් අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ සඳහා
(2026 මැයි මස 24 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල තැනින්
තැන වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සවස් කොලබේ බ ෝ රොත්‍රී
කොලබේ දී ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති විය ැක.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේගය පැ.කි.මී. (30-40) පමණ බේ. කන්කසන්ුරය සිට පුත්තලම,
බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ
බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. (50-60) පමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ
බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. 50 පමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක.
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
කන්කසන්ුරය සිට පුත්තලම, බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න්
වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට රළු ගේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ තරමක් රළු බේ.

central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 25 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 25 May 2026.
Southwest Monsoon is gradually establishing across the island, an increase in rainfall over the
southwestern parts of the island is expected during the next few days.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are
likely at some places in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 25 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
elsewhere around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and
from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other sea
areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Galle to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Advisory for Severe Lightning
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon 25 May 2026 valid for the period until 11.30 p.m. 25 May 2026
For Uva province, Ampara and Batticaloa districts
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
Thundershowers accompanied with
severe lightning are likely to occur at
some places in Uva province and in
Ampara and Batticaloa districts after
1.00 p.m.
There may be temporary localized
strong winds during thundershowers.
General public is kindly requested to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by lightning activity.
ACTION REQUIRED:
The Department of Meteorology
advises that people should:
 Seek shelter, preferably indoors and
never under trees.
 Avoid open areas such as paddy
fields, tea plantations and open
water bodies during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using wired telephones and connected electric appliances during thunderstorms.
 Avoid using open vehicles, such as bicycles, tractors and boats etc.
 Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
 For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.

2026 மே 25ஆம் திகதி பிற்பகல் 11.30 மணி வழையான காலப்பகுதிக்காக,

தயவுதசய்து அவதானமாக இருக்கவும்:
ஊவா மாகாணத்திலும் அம்பாழற மற்றும் மட்டக்களப்பு

தபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.

எடுக்க லவண்டிய நடவடிக்ழககள்:

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 26 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 25 May 2026
Southwest Monsoon is gradually establishing across the island, an increase in rainfall over the
southwestern parts of the island is expected during the next few days.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely
at some places in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 25 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other
sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Hambantota to Pottuvil (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 25 May 2026.
Southwest Monsoon is gradually establishing across the island, an increase in rainfall over the
southwestern parts of the island is expected during the next few days.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Heavy falls about 100 mm are
likely at some places in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 26 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other
sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Hambantota to Pottuvil (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 26 May 2026
South-west monsoon has established over the island. Therefore, an increase in rainfall over the
southwestern parts of the island is expected.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are
likely at some places in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

Bulletin No: 01 MHA/2026/05/26/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for High Waves and Strong Winds.
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 04.30 p.m. 26 May 2026
For the period from 04.30 p.m. 26 May 2026 to 04.30 p.m. 27 May 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo,
Galle and Hambantota.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times with strong gusty winds up to 60 kmph.
The swell waves (about 2.0 m – 3.0 m) height (This is not for land area) and wave period
(about 10s-14s) may increase in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kalpitiya to
Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle, and Hambantota.
There is a possibility that near shore sea areas off the coast extending from Kalpitiya to
Matara via Colombo and Galle, may experience surges due to swell waves.
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota can be rough at times.
The naval and fishing communities who are engaged in fishing and naval activities in the
above sea areas are requested to be vigilant in this regard.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 27 May 2026.
Th e
South-west monsoon has established over the island. The prevailing showery condition over the
south western parts of the island is expected to continue.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are
likely at some places in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 27 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places
in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other
sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Hambantota to Pottuvil (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 28 May 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 27 May 2026
Th e
South-west monsoon has established over the island. The prevailing showery condition over the
south western parts of the island is expected to continue.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 27 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other
sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle, and Hambantota. (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times with strong gusty winds up to 60 kmph.
The swell waves (about 2.0 m – 3.0 m) height (This is not for land area) may increase in the
sea areas off the coast extending from Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle, and
Hambantota.
The naval and fishing communities who are engaged in fishing and naval activities in the
above sea areas are requested to be vigilant in this regard.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 28 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 28 May 2026.
Th e
The prevailing showery condition over the south western parts of the island is expected to
continue.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are
likely at some places in Galle, Matara, Kaluthara and Rathnapura districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.

Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle, and Hambantota. (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 29 MAY 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 29 May 2026.
Th e
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa district after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 29 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (55-
65) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar
and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the
other sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Matara
to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be very rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be
fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle, and Hambantota. (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from

Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

text:
බහු දින යාත්‍රා සඳහා කාලගුණ අනාවැකිය
උතුරු අක්ාාංශ 20 ත් දකුණු අක්ාාංශ 10 ත් සහ නැගෙනහිර ගේශාාංශ 60 ත් 100 ත් අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ සඳහා
(2026 මැයි මස 30 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල තැනින් තැන
වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේගය පැ.කි.මී. (30-40) පමණ බේ. කන්කසන්ුරය සිට මන්නොරම
ර ො ලොවත ෙක්වො ස ගොල්ල සිට ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල
සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. (60-65) පමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල
සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට ෙැ.කි.මී. 50 පමණ ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක.
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
කන්කසන්ුරය සිට මන්නොරම ර ො ලොවත ෙක්වො ස ගොල්ල සිට ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට
ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට ඉතා රළු ගේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට තරමක රළු ගේ.
කල්පිටිය සිට ගකාළඹ, ොල්පල සහ හම්බන්ගතාට හරහා ගොතුවිල්ප දකවා ගවරළට ඔබ්ගබන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල
මුහුදු රළ උස මීටර් (2.0 – 2.5) ක පමණ ඉ ළ යොබම් ැකියොවක් පවතී. (බමය බගොඩබිමට එන රළ උස බනොබේ).
ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති වන විට එම මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල තාවකාලිකව තද සුළාං ඇති විය හැකි අතර එවිට එම මුහුදු
ප්‍රගේශ තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.
ගබාංොල ගබාකක මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශය

For the sea areas in between 20N - 10S and 60E-100E
(Issued at 07.00 a.m. on 30 May 2026, for next 24 hours)
Sea Areas Around the island
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-65)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and
from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other sea
areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and from Galle to

சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.

40 கிமலா மீற்றர் வழையான மவகத்தில் ஓைளவு பலத்த காற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்
படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை பபய்யும் மவழளகளில் அப் பிைமதசங்களில் தற்காலிகமாக வீசக் கூடிய
பலத்த காற்று மற்றும் மின்னல் தாக்கங்களினால் ஏற்படக்கூடிய பாதிப்புகழள

text:
அறிக்கை இல : 03 SWA/26/05/30/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான ஆலலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 மே 31ஆம் திைதி பிற்பைல் 04.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 மே 30ஆம் திைதி பிற்பைல் 04.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற மற்றும் மன்னார் ஊடாை சிலாபம் வகையான
ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கும் ைாலியிலிருந்து ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான
ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கும்:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற மற்றும்
மன்னார் ஊடாை சிலாபம் வகையான
ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் ைாலியிலிருந்து
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் அவ்வப்லபாது மிைவும்
கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின்
லவைமானது அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு
60-65 ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம்
கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம்
கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு
லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப்படுைிறீர்ைள்.
