WEATHER FORECAST FOR 01 June 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 31 May 2026
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 31 May 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-
65) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mullaittivu to Chilaw via
Kankasanthurai and Mannar and, from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up
to 50 kmph at times in the other sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Mullaittivu to Chilaw via Kankasanthurai and Mannar and,
from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be very rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Issued at 04.30 p.m. 31 May 2026
Valid for the period until 04.30 p.m. 01 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Mullaittivu to Chilaw via
Kankasanthurai, Mannar and from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas extending from
Mullaittivu to Chilaw via
Kankasanthurai and Mannar, and from
Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota will
be very rough at times with strong
gusty winds up to (60-65) kmph.
The naval and fishing communities who
are engaged in fishing and naval
activities in the above sea areas are
requested to be vigilant in this regard.

text:
இலங்ழகக்கான பபாதுவான வானிழல முன்னறிவிப்பு
மதசிய வளிமண்டலவியல் நிழலயத்தின் முன்னறிவிப்புப் பிாிவால் பவளியிடப்பட்டது.
அடுத்த 36 மணித்தியாலங்களுக்கான பபாதுவான வானிழல முன்னறிவிப்பு
2026 மே 31ஆம் திகதி பிற்பகல் 04.00 மணிக்கு பவளியிடப்பட்டது.
மமல், சப்ைகமுவ மற்றும் வடமமல் மாகாணங்களிலும் காலி, மாத்தழற, கண்டி மற்றும்
நுவபைலியா மாவட்டங்களிலும் அவ்வப்மபாது மழைமயா அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய மழைமயா
பபய்யக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது. மமல் மற்றும் சப்ைகமுவ மாகாணங்களிலும் காலி
மற்றும் மாத்தழற மாவட்டங்களிலும் சில இடங்களில் 50 மி.மீ க்கும் அதிகமான ஓைளவு பலத்த
மழைவீழ்ச்சி எதிர்பார்க்கப் படுகின்றது.
ஊவா மாகாணத்திலும் அம்பாழற மற்றும் மட்டக்களப்பு மாவட்டங்களிலும் சில இடங்களில்
பி.ப. 1.00 மணிக்குப் பின்னர் மழைமயா அல்லது இடியுடன் கூடிய மழைமயா பபய்யக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் காணப்படுகின்றது.
மத்திய மழலநாட்டின் மமற்கு சாிவுப் பகுதிகளிலும் வடக்கு, வடமத்திய, வடமமல் மற்றும் பதன்
மாகாணங்களிலும் திருமகாணமழல மாவட்டத்திலும் அவ்வப்மபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 30-
40 கிமலா மீற்றர் வழையான மவகத்தில் ஓைளவு பலத்த காற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்
படுகின்றது.
இடியுடன் கூடிய மழை பபய்யும் மவழளகளில் அப் பிைமதசங்களில் தற்காலிகமாக வீசக் கூடிய
பலத்த காற்று மற்றும் மின்னல் தாக்கங்களினால் ஏற்படக்கூடிய பாதிப்புகழள
குழறத்துக்பகாள்ள மதழவயான முன்பனச்சாிக்ழக நடவடிக்ழககழள எடுத்துக் பகாள்ளுமாறு
பபாதுமக்கள் அறிவுறுத்தப் படுகின்றார்கள்.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 01 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 01 June 2026.
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 01 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (55-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mullaittivu to Chilaw via
Kankasanthurai and Mannar and, from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase
up to 50 kmph at times in the other sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Mullaittivu to Chilaw via Kankasanthurai and Mannar
and, from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island will be fairly rough at times.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 01 June 2026
Rainy conditions are expected to be enhance in the southwestern parts of the island from
tomorrow (02 June) evening.
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places
in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 01 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (55-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar
and, from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the
other sea areas around the island.

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and, from Galle to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly
rough at times.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 01 June 2026
Rainy conditions are expected to be enhance in the southwestern parts of the island from
tomorrow (02 June) evening.
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places
in these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the
central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee
district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 02 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 02 June 2026.
Rainy conditions are expected to increase in the southwestern parts of the island from this evening
(02 June).
Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle,
Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in
these areas.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa
districts after 1.00 pm.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

ප්‍රයේශ තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.
WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 02 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be southwesterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (55-60)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and,
from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the other
sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and, from Galle to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be fairly rough
at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. (this is not for land area).
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான ஆலலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 03ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 02ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற, மன்னார், புத்தளம், ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற,
மன்னார், புத்தளம், ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக்
ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின் லவைமானது
அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60
ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம்
கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம்
கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு
லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப்படுைிறீர்ைள்.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 03 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times across the island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 04ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 03ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற, மன்னார், புத்தளம், கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற,
மன்னார், புத்தளம், கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக்
ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின் லவைமானது
அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60
ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம்
கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம்
கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு
லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப்படுைிறீர்ைள்.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 04 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 04 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills,
Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly strong
winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

text:
அறிக்கை இல : 03 MWA/26/06/04/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான ஆலலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 05ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 04ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற, மன்னார், புத்தளம், கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
முல்கலத்தீவிலிருந்து ைாங்லைசந்துகற,
மன்னார், புத்தளம், கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக்
ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின் லவைமானது
அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60
ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
மன்னாாிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2 – 3 மீற்றர்
உயைம் வகை லமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
சிலாபத்திலிருந்து கைாழும்பு மற்றும் ைாலி
ஊடாை மாத்தகற வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைகைகய அண்டிய பகுதிைளில் அகலைள்
அவ்வப்லபாது உயர்வாைக் ைாணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப் படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப்படுைிறீர்ைள்.

provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in

winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.

temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 05 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 05 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills,
Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly strong
winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 06 June 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 05 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 05 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-
70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be very rough at times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas
around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. The near shore sea areas from Chilaw to
Matara via Colombo and Galle may experience surges as well.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

மாவட்டங்களிலும் சில இடங்களில் 75 மி.மீ அளவான ஓைளவு பலத்த மழைவீழ்ச்சி

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 06 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 06 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 06 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-
70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be very rough at times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas
around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. The near shore sea areas from Chilaw to
Matara via Colombo and Galle may experience surges as well.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

උතුරු අක්ාාංශ 20 ත් දකුණු අක්ාාංශ 10 ත් සහ නැගෙනහිර ගේශාාංශ 60 ත් 100 ත් අතර මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ සඳහා
(2026 ජුනි මස 06 දින ගෙ.ව. 07.00 ට ඉදිරි ෙැය 24 සඳහා නිකුත් කරන ලදි.)
දිවයින වටා වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ
වැසි තත්ත්වය:
පුත්තලම සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල ර ො ම් න්බතොට ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල තැනින් තැන
වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති බේ.
සුළඟ:
සුළං නිරිත බෙසින් මො එන අතර සුළබේ බේගය පැ.කි.මී. (30-40) පමණ බේ. කන්කසන්තුරය සිට මන්නාරම
හරහා කල්පිටිය ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. (60-70) ෙක්වො
වැඩි විය ැකි අතර, ත්‍රිකුණොමලය සිට මුලතිේ ර ො කන්කසන්ුරය ෙක්වො ස කල්ිටිය සිට බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස
ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල සුළබේ බේගය විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී.
(50-60) ෙක්වො ඉ ළ යො ැක.
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
කන්කසන්තුරය සිට මන්නාරම හරහා කල්පිටිය දකවා ගවරළට ඔබ්ගබන් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ විටින් විට ඉතා රළු ගේ.
ත්‍රිකුණොමලය සිට මුලතිේ ර ො කන්කසන්ුරය ෙක්වො ස කල්ිටිය සිට බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො
බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින් විට රළු ගේ. දිවයින වටො වන බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ විටින්
විට තරමක් රළු බේ.
මන්නොරම සිට බකොළඹ, ගොල්ල ස ම් න්බතොට ර ො බපොුවිල් ෙක්වො බවරළට ඔබ්බ න් වන මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශවල
මුහුදු රළ උස මීටර් (2.0 – 2.5) ක් පමණ ඉ ළ යොබම් ැකියොවක් පවතින අතර ලොවත සිට බකොළඹ ස ගොල්ල
ර ො මොතර ෙක්වො බවරළ ආසන්න ප්‍රබේශවල මුහුදු රළ බගොඩබිමට පැමිණීබම් ැකියොවක් ෙ පවතී.
ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති වන විට එම මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශවල තාවකාලිකව තද සුළාං ඇති විය හැකි අතර එවිට එම මුහුදු
ප්‍රගේශ තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.
ගබාංොල ගබාකක මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශය
කාලගුණික තත්ත්වය:
02N - 20N, 90E-100E : බ ොබ ෝ ප්‍රබේශවල වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
EQ - 05N, 80E-90E : තැනින් තැන වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
සුළාං තත්ත්වය:
03N -15N, 80E-92E : නිරිත බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. (50-60) ෙක්වො.
05N -15N, 92E-100E : නිරිත බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. 50 ෙක්වො.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : නිරිත බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (20-40).
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
03N -15N, 80E-92E : තරමක් රළු, විටින් විට රළු.
05N -15N, 92E-100E : මෙ වශබයන් රළු; විටින් විට තරමක් රළු.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : මෙ වශබයන් රළු.

අරාබි මුහුද
කාලගුණික තත්ත්වය:
10N - 15N, 68E-75E : බ ොබ ෝ ප්‍රබේශවල වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
05N - 10N, 65E-80E : තැනින් තැන වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : ස්ථොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
සුළාං තත්ත්වය:
05N-10N, 75E-80E : නිරිත බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. (50-60).
10N-15N, 60E-75E : නිරිත බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. 50.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : ස්නොහිර සිට නිරිත ෙක්වො දිශොවලින් / පැ.කි.මී. (25-35).
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
05N-10N, 75E-80E : තරමක් රළු, විටින් විට රළු.
10N-15N, 60E-75E : මෙ වශබයන් රළු; විටින් විට තරමක් රළු.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : මෙ වශබයන් රළු.
දකුණු ඉන්දියානු සාෙරය
කාලගුණික තත්ත්වය :
05S-10S, 75E-100E : තැනින් තැන වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : සථ් ොන ස්වල්පයක වැසි බ ෝ ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි.
සුළාං තත්ත්වය:
05S -10S, 75E-100E : ගිනිබකොන බෙසින් / පැ.කි.මී. (30-40); විටින් විට පැ.කි.මී. 50
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : ගිනිබකොන බෙසින් බ ෝ නිශ්ිත දිශොවකින් බතොරව / පැ.කි.මී. (20-30).
මුහුගේ ස්වභාවය:
05S -10S, 75E-100E : මෙ වශබයන් රළු; විටින් විට තරමක් රළු.
බසසු මුහුදු ප්‍රබේශ : සොමොනය ස්වභොවබේ සිට මෙ වශබයන් රළු.
**ගිගුරුම් සහිත වැසි ඇති වන විට තද සුළාං සමඟ එම මුහුදු ප්‍රගේශ තාවකාලිකව ඉතා රළු විය හැක.

Weather forecast for multi-day boats
For the sea areas in between 20N - 10S and 60E-100E
(Issued at 07.00 a.m. on 06 June 2026, for next 24 hours)
Sea Areas Around the island
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-70)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and Kalpitiya
to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. The near shore sea areas from Chilaw to Matara
via Colombo and Galle may experience surges as well.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 11.30 a.m. 06 June 2026
Valid for the period until 11.30 a.m. 07 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via
Mullaittivu, Kankasanthurai, Mannar, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar will be very rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (60-70) kmph.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via
Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be
rough at times with strong gusty winds
up to (50-60) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil
via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota. The
near shore sea areas from Chilaw to
Matara via Colombo and Galle may
experience surges as well.
The naval and fishing communities engaging fishing and naval activities in the
aforementioned sea areas are requested to be vigilant in this regard.

description: Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas (Tamil Language)
text:
அறிக்கை இல : 05 MWA/26/06/06/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான ஆலலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 07ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 11.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 06ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 11.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
திருலைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு, ைாங்லைசந்துகற, மன்னார், புத்தளம்,
கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான
ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
ைாங்லைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது
மிைவும் கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 60-70
ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகையான லவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது.
திருலைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு
ஊடாை ைாங்லைசந்துகற வகையான
ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு,
ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை
கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளும் அவ்வப்லபாது
கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின்
லவைமானது அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய
சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.

மன்னாாிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான
ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2.0 – 2.5 மீற்றர் உயைம் வகை
லமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
சிலாபத்திலிருந்து கைாழும்பு மற்றும் ைாலி ஊடாை மாத்தகற வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைகைகய
அண்டிய பகுதிைளில் அகலைள் அவ்வப்லபாது உயர்வாைக் ைாணப்படும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப்படுைிறீர்ைள்.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 07 JUNE 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 06 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura district.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills,
Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly strong
winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to

Hambantota.

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very rough
at times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya

island will be fairly rough at times.

Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

DAMAGE EXPECTED:
• Damage to roof tiles/ sheets etc.
• Damage to power and communication lines.
• Breaking of tree branches and uprooting of large avenue trees.
• Damage to paddy crops, banana, papaya trees and orchards.
• Damage to harbor yachts
• Sea water inundation in low lying areas in the near coast.
ACTION SUGGESTED:
• Be cautious of potential hazards caused by damaged roof tiles or sheets.
• Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
• Be vigilant regarding impending extreme weather situation.
• For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.
• Requested to be attentive about future advisories issued by the Department of Meteorology
in this regard.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 07 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to
Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-70)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very rough at
times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to
Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island
will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar
to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 06.30 a.m. 07 June 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 08 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar.
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar will be very rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (60-70) kmph.
Naval and fishing communities are
advised not to venture into these sea
areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via
Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be
rough at times with strong gusty winds
up to (50-60) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil
via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be attentive to future forecasts issued by the Department of Meteorology in
this regard.

இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 08ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 07ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 06.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
நடவடிக்கக எடுக்கவும்!
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு

மிைவும் கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 60-70
ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகையான கவைத்தில் பலத்த

மீனவ சமூைமும் மறு அறிவித்தல் வகை
கமற்குறிப்பிட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடுவகதத் தவிர்த்துக்
கைாள்ளுமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
திருகைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 08 JUNE 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 07 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
A few showers may occur in Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

எதிர்பரர்க்ைப்படும் லசதங்ைள்:
• கூகர ஓடுகள், தைரங்ைளுக்கு லசதங்ைள் ஏற்பட ரம்
• மின்சார மற்றும் த ாலைத்த ாடர்பு கம்பிகளுக்கு லசதங்ைள் ஏற்பட ரம்
• மரக் ைிகளைள் முறிந்து விழ ரம், லமலும் பரரிய மரங்ைள் லவருடன் சரய ரம்
• தெல் வயல்கள், வாலைத் த ாட்டங்கள், பப்பாசி மரங்கள் மற்றும் பைத் த ாட்டங்களுக்கு
லசதங்ைள் ஏற்பட ரம்
• துகறமுைத்தில் நிறுத்தி கவக்ைப் பட்டிருக்கும் படகுைளுக்கு லசதங்ைள் ஏற்பட ரம்
• ைகரலயரரத்திற்கு அண்கமயில் உள்ள பிரலதசங்ைளில் தரழ் நி ப் பகுதிைளில் ைடல் நீர்
உட்புை ரம்
ஆல ரசகை வழங்ைப்படும் நடவடிக்கைைள்:
• தச மலடந் கூலர ஓடுகள் அல்ைது கடுகளால் ஏற்படக்கூடிய அபாயங்கள் குறித்து
எச்சாிக்லகயாக இருக்ைவும்
• விழுந்த மரங்ைள், மின்ைம்பிைள் குறித்து அவதரைமரை இருக்ைவும்
• மிைவும் லமரசமரை வரைிக குறித்து அவதரைமரை இருக்குமரறு லவண்டிக்
தைரள்ளப்படுைிறீர்ைள்.
• அவசர உதவிைளுக்கு உங்ைள் பிரலதச அைர்த்த முைரகமத்துவ அதிைரரிைகளத் ததரடர்பு
தைரள்ளவும்
• இவ்விடயம் ததரடர்பரை வளிமண்ட வியல் திகணக்ைளத்தரல் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைர

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 08 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 08 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
A few showers may occur in Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 08 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to
Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-70)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very rough
at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas, until further
notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya
to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

description: Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
text:
Bulletin No: 07 MWW/2026/06/08/01
COLOR: Red
Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 08 June 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 09 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar.
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar will be very rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (60-70) kmph.
Naval and fishing communities are
advised not to venture into these sea
areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via
Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be
rough at times with strong gusty winds
up to (50-60) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil
via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be attentive to future forecasts issued by the Department of Meteorology in
this regard.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 09 JUNE 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 08 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy
district.
A few showers may occur in Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 08 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to
Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (60-70)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very rough
at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas, until further
notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya
to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the
island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 08 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy
district.
A few showers may occur in Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 09 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.

from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be
very rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea
areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 10ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 09ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
நடவடிக்கக எடுக்கவும்!
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்கபாது
மிைவும் கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 60-70
ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகையான கவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது. ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும்
மீனவ சமூைமும் மறு அறிவித்தல் வகை
கமற்குறிப்பிட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடுவகதத் தவிர்த்துக்
கைாள்ளுமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
திருகைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு
ஊடாை ைாங்கைசந்துகற வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு,
ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட

அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்

Issued by Forecasting Division, National Meteorological Centre
WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 09 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 10 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
A few showers may occur in Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 10 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

text:
அறிக்கை இல : 09 MWA/26/06/10/01
நிறம் : சிவப்பு
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான எச்சாிக்கை:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 11ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 10ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
நடவடிக்கக எடுக்கவும்!
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்கபாது
மிைவும் கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 60-70
ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகையான கவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது. ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும்
மீனவ சமூைமும் மறு அறிவித்தல் வகை
கமற்குறிப்பிட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடுவகதத் தவிர்த்துக்
கைாள்ளுமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
திருகைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு
ஊடாை ைாங்கைசந்துகற வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு,
ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் அவ்வப்கபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின் கவைமானது
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
ைாணப்படுைின்றது.

மன்னாாிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2.0 – 2.5 மீற்றர் உயைம் வகை
கமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை வளிமண்டலவியல் திகணக்ைளத்தால் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைால
முன்னறிவிப்புைள் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு கவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப் படுைிறீர்ைள்.

Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 10 June 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 11 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar.
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar will be very rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (60-70) kmph.
Naval and fishing communities are
advised not to venture into these sea
areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via
Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be
rough at times with strong gusty winds up
to (50-60) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil
via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Naval and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to future forecasts issued by
the Department of Meteorology in this regard.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 11 JUNE 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 10 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm
are likely at some places in these areas.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 10 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 11 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 11 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm
are likely at some places in these areas.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 11 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 11 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm

hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Advisory for Strong winds
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 06.00 p.m. 11 June 2026, valid until 06.00 p.m. 12 June 2026
For Central, Sabaragamuwa, Northern, North-central provinces and
Trincomalee, Hambantota districts.
BE PREPARED!
Strong winds of about (40-50)
kmph can be expected at times
over Central, Sabaragamuwa,
Northern and North-central
provinces and in Trincomalee and
Hambantota districts, due to the
active south-west monsoonal
condition.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40)
kmph can be expected at times
elsewhere of the island.
Color: -Red Color: -Amber Color: -Green
Waning (Take action) Advisory (Be prepared) Threat is over

DAMAGE EXPECTED:
• Damage to roof tiles/ sheets etc.
• Damage to power and communication lines.
• Breaking of tree branches and uprooting of large avenue trees.
• Damage to paddy crops, banana, papaya trees and orchards.
• Damage to harbor yachts
• Sea water inundation in low lying areas in the near coast.
ACTION SUGGESTED:
• Be cautious of potential hazards caused by damaged roof tiles or sheets.
• Beware of fallen trees and power lines.
• Be vigilant regarding impending extreme weather situation.
• For emergency assistance contact the local disaster management authorities.
• Requested to be attentive about future advisories issued by the Department of Meteorology
in this regard.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 12 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 12 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm
are likely at some places in these areas.
Several spells of showers may occur in Hambantota and Anuradhapura districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 12 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.

from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

description: Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas (Tamil Language)
text:
அறிக்கை இல : 11 MWA/2026/06/12/01
நிறம் : சிவப்பு
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான எச்சாிக்கை:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 13ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 12ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
நடவடிக்கக எடுக்கவும்!
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்கபாது
மிைவும் கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 60-70
ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகையான கவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது. ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும்
மீனவ சமூைமும் மறு அறிவித்தல் வகை
கமற்குறிப்பிட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடுவகதத் தவிர்த்துக்
கைாள்ளுமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
திருகைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு
ஊடாை ைாங்கைசந்துகற வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு,
ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் அவ்வப்கபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின் கவைமானது
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
ைாணப்படுைின்றது.

மன்னாாிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2.0 – 2.5 மீற்றர் உயைம் வகை
கமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை வளிமண்டலவியல் திகணக்ைளத்தால் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைால
முன்னறிவிப்புைள் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு கவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப் படுைிறீர்ைள்.

Issued at 10.30 a.m. 12 June 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 13 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar.
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar will be very rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (60-70) kmph.
Naval and fishing communities are
advised not to venture into these sea
areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via
Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be
rough at times with strong gusty winds up
to (50-60) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil
via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 12 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm
are likely at some places in these areas.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 13 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 13 June 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm
are likely at some places in these areas.
Several spells of showers may occur in Mannar and Anuradhapura districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 13 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Hambantota via Puttalam, Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to
(60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya
via Mannar.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and from Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo,
Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaittivu and
from Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other
sea areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

description: Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas (Tamil Language)
text:
அறிக்கை இல : 12 MWA/2026/06/13/01
நிறம் : சிவப்பு
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான எச்சாிக்கை:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 14ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 13ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
நடவடிக்கக எடுக்கவும்!
ைாங்கைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்கபாது
மிைவும் கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 60-70
ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகையான கவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது.
ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும்
மறு அறிவித்தல் வகை கமற்குறிப்பிட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளில் நடவடிக்கைைளில்
ஈடுபடுவகதத் தவிர்த்துக் கைாள்ளுமாறு
அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
திருகைாணமகலயிலிருந்து முல்கலத்தீவு
ஊடாை ைாங்கைசந்துகற வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு,
ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளும் அவ்வப்கபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன் ைாற்றின் கவைமானது
அவ்வப்கபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 ைிகலா மீற்றர் வகை அதிைாிக்ைக் கூடிய சாத்தியம்
ைாணப்படுைின்றது. இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம்

கசய்கவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப்
படுைின்றார்ைள்.
மன்னாாிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்கதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான
ைகைகயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2.0 – 2.5 மீற்றர் உயைம் வகை
கமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்கவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை வளிமண்டலவியல் திகணக்ைளத்தால் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைால
முன்னறிவிப்புைள் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு கவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப் படுைிறீர்ைள்.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 14 JUNE 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 13 June 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 50 mm
are likely at some places in these areas.
A few showers may occur in Mannar and Anuradhapura districts.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle.

via Mannar.

from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle
and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar will be very
rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to venture into these sea areas,
until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via Mullaitivu and
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil Via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea
areas around the island will be fairly rough at times.

from Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.

• Damage to power and communication lines.

Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Colombo to Hambantota via Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via
Kankasanthurai, Mannar, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Pottuvil via Kankasanthurai, Mannar,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will be rough at times. The fishing and naval communities engaged
in activities in these sea areas are advised to be attentive to this situation. The other sea areas
around the island will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 15ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 14ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது கைாந்தளிப்பாைக்
ைாணப்படுவதுடன் அவ்வப்லபாது
மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60 ைிலலா மீற்றர்
வகையான லவைத்தில் பலத்த ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும்
என எதிர்பார்க்ைப் படுைின்றது. இக்
ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில்
ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை
அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப்
படுைின்றார்ைள்.
ைாங்லைசந்துகறயிலிருந்து மன்னார் ஊடாை
கல்பிட்டி வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைளில்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடுவகதத் தவிர்த்துக்
கைாள்ளுமாறு முன்னர் விடுக்கப் பட்ட எச்சரிக்கக இதன் மூலம் திரும்பப் பபறப் படுகிறது.

மன்னாாிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும் ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான

லமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை வளிமண்டலவியல் திகணக்ைளத்தால் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைால
முன்னறிவிப்புைள் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப் படுைிறீர்ைள்.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 JUNE 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 14 June 2026
Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in
Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 2.00 p.m.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills,
Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly strong
winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.

Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 14 June 2026
Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and
in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces after 2.00 p.m.
Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts. Fairly
strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over other areas of island.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 JUNE 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 June 2026.
Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in
Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern provinces and in Mullaittivu
district after 2.00 p.m.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central
hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 June 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Matara via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and Colombo.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and
Colombo will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kalpitiya to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

description: Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas (Tamil Language)
text:
அறிக்கை இல : 14 MWA/2026/06/15/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான ஆலலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 16ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 15ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாலியிலிருந்து ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
ைாலியிலிருந்து ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை
கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது
கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60
ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகையான லவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது. இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம்
கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம்
கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு
அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2.0 – 2.5
மீற்றர் உயைம் வகை லமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை வளிமண்டலவியல் திகணக்ைளத்தால் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைால
முன்னறிவிப்புைள் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப் படுைிறீர்ைள்.

Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Matara via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-
60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Trincomalee to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and Colombo.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Trincomalee to Galle via Kankasanthurai, Puttalam and
Colombo will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Colombo to Pottuvil via Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.

Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.

temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

text:
அறிக்கை இல : 15 MWA/2026/06/16/01
நிறம் : ஆம்பர்
ைடும் ைாற்று மற்றும் கைாந்தளிப்பான ைடல் கதாடர்பான ஆலலாசகன:
இயற்கை அனர்த்தம் கதாடர்பான முன்கனச்சாிக்கை நிகலயத்தினால்,
2026 ஜூன் 17ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணி வகை கசல்லுபடியாகும் வகையில்
2026 ஜூன் 16ஆம் திைதி முற்பைல் 10.30 மணியில் கவளியிடப்பட்டது.
ைாலியிலிருந்து ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைடற்பைப்புைளுக்கு:
தயவுகசய்து அவதானமாை இருக்ைவும்!
ைாலியிலிருந்து ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை
கபாத்துவில் வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு
அப்பாற்பட்ட ைடற்பைப்புைள் அவ்வப்லபாது
கைாந்தளிப்பாைக் ைாணப்படுவதுடன்
அவ்வப்லபாது மணித்தியாலத்துக்கு 50-60
ைிலலா மீற்றர் வகையான லவைத்தில் பலத்த
ைாற்று வீசக் கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்ைப்
படுைின்றது. இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார்
நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம்
கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம்
கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு
அறிவுறுத்தப் படுைின்றார்ைள்.
கல்பிட்டியிலிருந்து கைாழும்பு, ைாலி மற்றும்
ஹம்பாந்லதாட்கட ஊடாை கபாத்துவில்
வகையான ைகைலயாைத்திற்கு அப்பாற்பட்ட
ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல் அகலைள் 2.0 – 2.5
மீற்றர் உயைம் வகை லமகலழும்பக் கூடிய சாத்தியம் ைாணப்படுைின்றது.
இக் ைடற்பைப்புைளில் ைடல்சார் நடவடிக்கைைளில் ஈடுபடும் ைடலில் பயணம் கசய்லவாரும் மீனவ
சமூைமும் இவ்விடயம் கதாடர்பாை வளிமண்டலவியல் திகணக்ைளத்தால் வழங்ைப்படும் எதிர்ைால
முன்னறிவிப்புைள் கதாடர்பாை அவதானமாை இருக்குமாறு லவண்டிக் கைாள்ளப் படுைிறீர்ைள்.
